abstract: Extraction of VCSEL rate equation model parameters through joint optimization of modulation response and RIN spectra is presented. It accurately accounts for both ISI and noise, and employs drive-dependent parasitics found in VCSELs.

articleTitle: Scheduling Algorithm for All-optical Switch under Non-uniform Traffic Condition
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a scheduling algorithm for all-optical data center switch supporting high throughput and low delay for non-uniform traffic condition. Simulation result shows that our system achieves 100% throughput and shorter delay than existing methods.

articleTitle: Single-carrier 48-GBaud PDM-256QAM Transmission Over Unrepeated 100km Pure-silica-core Fiber Using Commercially Available μITLA and LN-IQ-modulator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Record symbol-rate PDM-256QAM single-carrier transmission over 100km is achieved using commercially available laser and modulator with only applying compensation for linear frequency response of transceiver and receiver; device nonlinearity compensation is not used.

articleTitle: How Much Is CD ROADM Contention Blocking?
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper models CD ROADM network contention blocking and shows that the contention blocking impact is marginal when CD ROADM add/drop port usage is less than 75%. Numerical results verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Self-Holding Operation of Magneto-Optical Switch using Thin-Film Magnet
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel self-holding switch is demonstrated by a magneto-optical waveguide switch. The switching state is flipped by a pulsed current and maintained without any power supply by virtue of the non-volatility of thin-film magnet.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity of Optical Fibers: A tutorial
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber nonlinearities are regarded as being harmful for optical communication systems, although they are useful for applications such as Raman amplification and supercontinuum generation. In this tutorial I review them and discuss their practical implications.

articleTitle: Coherent Receiver DSP Implemented on a General-Purpose Server for Full Software-Defined Optical Access
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel softwarized access scheme combined with DSP-enabled (de)modulation approaches and demonstrate a real-time coherent detection of 5-Gbit/s QPSK signals on a general-purpose server for a full software-defined platform for the first time.

articleTitle: 10-Gbps Real-time Burst-Frame Synchronization Using Dual-Stage Detection for Full-Software Optical Access Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: For realizing full-software optical access systems, we propose a novel burst-frame synchronization algorithm with reduced computation complexity using dual-stage detection and, for the first time, demonstrate its 10-Gbps real-time implementation on a GPU.

articleTitle: Experimental Effect of Scattering on an 80-Gbit/s QPSK Wireless Link using 4 Orbital-Angular-Momentum Beams
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the effect of multiple scattering on the performance of an 80-Gbit/s orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexed optical wireless link regarding both power loss and channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: Multiplane Orbital Angular Momentum and Wavelength Switch based on Integrated Tunable Vortex Emitters
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A multiplane switch architecture exploiting OAM and wavelength domains is characterized in terms of BER, scheduling/reconfiguration latency, and power consumption. Doubling the exploited OAM modes reduces the latency by 42% and the power by 17%.

articleTitle: Blind and Fast Modulation Format Identification by Frequency-offset Loading for Hitless Flexible Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a blind and fast modulation format identification enabled by frequency-offset loading technique for hitless flexible transceiver. Arbitrary format switching among 28-Gbaud DP-4/8/16/64QAM, hybrid-4/16QAM, and SP-128QAM can be accurately identified with only 2048 symbols.

articleTitle: High-Speed High-Efficiency Broadband Silicon Photodiodes for Short-Reach Optical Interconnects in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-based surface-illuminated CMOS-compatible broadband photodiode with ≤30ps FWHM and above 55% EQE at 850nm for up to 50Gb/s by using photon-trapping micro/nano-structures. This is the fastest reported response for a Silicon photodiode.

articleTitle: Linearly Polarized Multi-wavelength Comb via Rayleigh Scattering induced Brillouin Random Lasing Resonance
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A linearly polarized kHz-linewidth multi-wavelength comb in the telecom spectral window with over-40-dB OSNR was experimentally demonstrated by randomly distributed Rayleigh scattering induced Brillouin lasing oscillation in polarization maintaining fibers.

articleTitle: An Automated Service-downgrade Negotiation Scheme for Application-centric Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel negotiation scheme for an application-driven relaxation of different requirements in multi-layer networks. Simulative results show that it improves service acceptance while keeping requirements' degradation much lower than applications' worst-case acceptable values.

articleTitle: Single Photodiode-per-Polarization Receiver for 400G Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a simplified heterodyne receiver using one single ended photodiode per polarization for polarization multiplexed coherent signals. We demonstrate this receiver for the reception of PM-16QAM over field-installed metro-area fibers at distances up to 306-km.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s Low-Cost Directly Modulated Multi-Electrode Laser with Suppressed Thermal Wavelength Drift for Burst-Mode Upstream Transmission in TWDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a novel 10Gb/s low-cost multi-electrode DML employed as a very wavelength stable burst-mode source for upstream TWDM-PONs. 10X wavelength drift reduction is achieved compared to conventional DMLs enabling transmission on 100GHz grid.

articleTitle: DSP-Free Coherent Receivers for Data Center Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review low-power DSP-free coherent receiver architectures for DP-QPSK that exhibit performance comparable to their DSP-based counterparts, while consuming an estimated ~ 4 W for 200 Gbit/s DP-QPSK in 90-nm CMOS.

articleTitle: On-chip Continuously Tunable Optical Delay Line Based on Cascaded Mach-Zehnder Interferometers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel integrated optical delay line based on cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers. It allows a continuous delay tuning, can achieve wideband operation and is experimentally demonstrated with a delay up to 125 ps.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning to Achieve Efficient Resource Allocation with Traffic Evaluation in Datacenter Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper first presents a deep learning-based resource allocation strategy supported by global evaluate factor in intra-datacenter optical networks. Numerical results show the proposed strategy improves traffic prediction accuracy and has superior performance.

articleTitle: Scalable mode sorter supporting 210 Hermite-Gaussian modes
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a multi-plane light conversion device based on 7 planes which maps Hermite-Gaussian spatial modes with indices (m, n) onto a Cartesian grid (x, y) of diffraction limited spots for 210 spatial modes.

articleTitle: Modulation Format, Spectrum and Core Assignment in a Multicore Flexi-Grid Optical Link
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We model and solve the core and spectrum assignment problem in a multicore flexi-grid link, considering distance-adaptive reaches for different modulation formats and crosstalk impairments. Problem complexity and exemplifying numerical results on 19-core fibers are discussed.

articleTitle: The Role of Standards for Cloud-Scale Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Standards play an increasingly important role for cloud providers considering the dramatic growth that cloud services are experiencing. Distinctions are made between open consortia, multi-source agreements, and standards, and case studies with lessons learned are presented.

articleTitle: Successive Four-Dimensional Stokes-Space Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a successive detection scheme for the fourth dimension in a four-dimensional Stokes-space direct detection receiver. At the expense of a small number of electrical-domain computations, the additional information rate can be substantial.

articleTitle: Automated Management and Control of a Multi-Vendor Disaggregated Network at the L0 Layer
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to demonstrate automated service management and automated optical power controls over Infinera and Lumentum Open Optical Line Systems using an Infinera Layer-0 SDN controller.

articleTitle: Simultaneous DPSK-ASK Modulated Dual-EML Transmitter for Coherent UDWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An integrated dual-EML is modulated to obtain a simultaneous DPSK/ASK signal. Rx sensitivity of -40 dBm at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> was achieved at 5Gb/s with simple heterodyne detection.

articleTitle: Compact and Power Efficient 2 × 2 Thermo-Optical Switch Based on Dual-Nanobeam MZI
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A compact 2×2 thermo-optical switch based on a dual-nanobeam MZI is experimentally demonstrated. The footprint is 38 μm×84 μm. The heating powers for the cross and bar states are ~2.66 mW and ~2.36 mW, respectively.

articleTitle: Inter-die Fabrication Uniformity of Silicon Photonic Fiber-to-waveguide Edge Couplers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon-on-insulator fiber-to-waveguide inverse taper edge couplers of different tip widths of 120nm to 200nm are fabricated using a multi-project wafer service. The coupling efficiencies and the inter-die fabrication uniformity of the edge couplers are compared.

articleTitle: High-Capacity SDM Transmission Over Transoceanic Distances (Invited)
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent experimental and theoretical works that discuss capacity and power efficiency improvements achievable in transoceanic transmission with SDM. We outline challenges and potential solutions for increasing the capacity of future SDM undersea transmission.

articleTitle: Decision Tree Classification based Mix-flows scheduling in Optical Switched DCNs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel mix-flows scheduling strategy assisted with decision tree based flow classification for optical switched DCNs. Experimental results show it can effectively lower the completion time of small interactive flows and Coflows.

articleTitle: Advanced DSP Technologies with Symbol-rate over 100-Gbaud for High-capacity Optical Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 100-Gbaud-class systems are promising candidates for over 400-Gbps serial long-haul transport without increasing the number of transponders. We review DSP technologies, e.g. signal generation, calibration, post compensation and advanced modulation for realizing 100-Gbaud-class transceivers.

articleTitle: Optical Nanofiber Technologies for Single Photon Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Optical nanofiber technologies are discussed for both bare nanofibers and cavity created nanofibers. Emphasis is on the single-photon channeling into the fiber guided modes with a hybrid system of an optical-nanofiber and a single quantum-emitter.

articleTitle: Injection-locked Homodyne Detection for Higher-order QAM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present recent advances on an injection-locked homodyne detection system and its application to higher-order QAM transmission. A simple injection locking circuit enables precise optical carrier-phase synchronization. We describe a 216 Gbit/s, 512QAM-160 km transmission.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonic Systems for RF Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Microwave photonics continues to bring expanded capabilities for RF sensing applications New opportunities for technology insertion in a variety of RF sensor platforms Multiband, multifunctional sensing systems □ In addition to challenging performance specifications, other requirements of RF sensor platforms will drive technology innovations SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power) considerations Environmental requirements.

articleTitle: Demonstration of On-chip 640-Gbit/s Throughput, Granularity-flexible Programmable Optical Filtering and Reconfigurable Optical Add/drop Multiplexing on Silicon Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: By integrating cascaded arrayed-waveguide gratings with array switches on silicon platform, we design and fabricate an on-chip multi-functional photonic signal processor. 640-Gbit/s throughput, granularity-flexible programmable optical filtering and reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexing are demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Analog Transmission using Mode Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate MDM-based analog fiber-optic link to further increase link gain and reduce nonlinearity. Compared with using LP11 mode only in FMF, MDM-based link increases the SFDR by 4.6dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Propagation Equations for Arbitrary Levels of Random Linear Coupling Between Modes
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We derive expressions that enable the study of the impact of arbitrary levels of linear coupling between spatial modes on nonlinear propagation in space-division multiplexed transmission systems, valid for both multimode and coupled-core fibers.

articleTitle: 20-year Reliability Test Results for SC Connector Installed on Outside Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Since 1997 we have tested the reliability of SC connectors installed outdoors in hot and humid environments. SC connectors with optimized ferrule end dimensions have maintained good optical performance for 20 years.

articleTitle: Optical Performance Monitoring in Fiber-Optic Networks Enabled by Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review applications of machine learning (ML) in various aspects of optical communications including optical performance monitoring, fiber nonlinearity compensation, and software-defined networking. The future role of ML in optical communications is also discussed.

articleTitle: Free Space Intra-Datacenter Interconnection Utilizing 2D Optical Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate the performance and benefits of novel integrated Free-Space-Optics (FSO) transceivers, supporting optical beam steering at low power consumption with ns steering speed. A proper intra-datacenter network architecture is also presented.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast Hitless 100Gbit/s Real-Time Bandwidth Variable Transmitter with SDN optical control
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We designed an ultra-fast real-time bandwidth-variable transmitter achieving zero-packet loss with ~10μs switching time, ~40× faster than previous record. We use a new coding scheme to generate baud rates and measure reconfiguration through SDN control.

articleTitle: An Accurate Algorithm to Quantitatively Identify the Performance Degradation Caused by Linear Crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A new algorithm to estimate the signal impairment by linear crosstalk is proposed. Experiments demonstrate the linear relationship between the Q penalty and crosstalk indicator with R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.98 under various transmission distances and conditions.

articleTitle: Dynamic Multiwavelength Optical Reflection Filter Induced in a Suspended-Core Fiber Bragg Grating by Amplitude Modulated Acoustic Waves
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A new technique to generate a multiwavelength reflection spectrum by modulating a 1cm long fiber Bragg grating with an amplitude modulated acoustic wave is reported. Up to 15 wavelength peaks with ~5pm bandwidth are achieved.

articleTitle: 448-Gb/s PAM4 Transmission Over 300-km SMF-28 Without Dispersion Compensation Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report on 4×112Gb/s direct-detection PAM4 transmission over 300-km standard single mode fiber. Chromatic dispersion is digitally compensated at the transmitter side.

articleTitle: Entropy Loading for Band-Limited Meshed-Optical-Networks: The Multicarrier Advantage
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Modern meshed optical networks deploy plentiful cascaded-ROADMs to enhance the network flexibility, which induce severe filter narrowing effect. We reveal the linear advantage of multicarrier by the optimum power allocation and capacity-approaching modulation.

articleTitle: Single-Channel 480-Gb/s Direct Detection of POL-MUX IQ Signal Using Single-Sideband Stokes Vector Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the single-sideband Stokes vector receiver to demultiplex a 4-D signal that fundamentally solves the carrier fading of POL-MUX direct detection, verified by a POL-MUX 60-Gbaud 16-QAM transmission over 80-km SSMF with digital dispersion post-compensation.

articleTitle: Optical Networks Throughput Enhancement via TCP Stop-and-Wait on Hybrid Switches
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report on possible 50% throughput increase in Optical Packet Switching (OPS) data-center networks by replacing all-optical switches with optical switches with shared electronic buffers further enhanced with TCP Stop-and-Wait algorithms.

articleTitle: Lossless Operation of SOA-Integrated Silicon Photonics Switch for 8 × 32-Gbaud 16-QAM WDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate lossless transmission of 8-channel 32-Gbaud 16-QAM WDM signals through a 4×4 silicon PILOSS switch with a flip-chip bonded 4-ch InP-based SOA. Transmission up to 4 stages was confirmed by optimizing nonlinearity and OSNR.

articleTitle: Comparison of SDM-WDM based Data Center Networks with equal/unequal core pitch Multi-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A wavelength-dependent crosstalk calculation formula for bi-directional MCF with unequal core pitches is derived. SDM-WDM based DCN simulations indicate that MCF core density and layout play a significant role on optimizing various scales of DCNs.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Stable 3×10 Gb/s Mode Group-multiplexed Transmission over a 20 km Few-mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate stable 3×10 Gb/s mode group-multiplexed transmission over a 20 km few-mode fiber using OOK modulation and direct detection. Stability in transmission was achieved by combining all degenerate modes at the receiver.

articleTitle: Noise Prediction and Cancellation Algorithm for the Bandwidth Limited PAM-4 System in the Presence of Intra-Channel Homodyne Crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: As a low-complexity solution, this paper proposes the use of noise prediction and cancellation (NPC) algorithm in a PAM-4 system, which achieves similar performance as the MLSE based PAM-4 receiver and increases tolerance towards intra-channel homodyne crosstalk.

articleTitle: Fast, Low-Complexity Widely-Linear Compensation for IQ Imbalance in Burst-Mode 100-Gb/s/λ Coherent TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose fast, low-complexity widely-liner compensation for IQ imbalance in 100-Gb/s/λ coherent TDM-PON. The proposed method reduces the power penalty to 0.3 dB, achieving 32.4-dB loss budget for 100-Gb/s DP-QPSK bursts with an 826-ns overhead.

articleTitle: Network Slicing Resource Allocation and Monitoring over Multiple Clouds and Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This demo presents an in-operation network slice resource allocator, which is able to consider networking and cloud infrastructure. Monitoring cloud and network resources allows enhancing the (re-)allocation of network slices, while accommodating novel slice requests.

articleTitle: DSP for High-Speed Fiber-Wireless Convergence
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent advances in the common public radio interfaces (CPRI/eCPRI) between remote radio units and baseband units via optical fiber, and discuss how DSP may be used to support both CPRI and eCPRI to achieve high bandwidth efficiency and low processing latency.

articleTitle: Network Orchestration for Dynamic Network Slicing for Fixed and Mobile Vertical Services
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate how a hybrid and hierarchical transport-SDN control plane based on a network orchestrator and an SDN controller can provide dynamic network slicing for enterprise-networking services and mobile metro-core networks.

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication and Demonstration of Ultra-Broadband Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Modes Emitter and Synthesizer on Silicon Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We design, fabricate and demonstrate chip-scale ultra-broadband orbital angular momentum (OAM) emitter and synthesizer on a silicon platform. The maximum purity of OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1</sub> and synthesized OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1</sub> and OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub> are 0.93 and 0.9 in telecommunication band.

articleTitle: Converged Access/Metro Infastructures for 5G services
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper focuses on Converged Access/Metro Infrastructures for 5G services proposing the novel “Dis-Aggregated RAN” architecture adopting “disaggregation” of hardware and software components across wireless, optical and compute/storage domains. The proposed approach is theoretically evaluated.

articleTitle: A Large-signal Equivalent Circuit for Depletion-type Silicon Ring Modulators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an accurate and easy-to-use large-signal equivalent circuit for depletion-type Si ring modulators. Design optimization of a 25-Gbps Si photonic transmitter including the driver and the modulator is carried out entirely with SPICE simulation.

articleTitle: Disaggregated Optical Data Center in a Box Network using Parallel OCS Topologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Two parallel OCS topologies are proposed that deliver 95 nsec round-trip latency on disaggregated optical data center in a box system. They offer 40% cost and 68% power consumption efficiency at maximum IT resource utilization.

articleTitle: Guaranteed-Availability Network Function Virtualization in Inter-Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Considering the availability of the datacenter's network elements, we propose a coordinated protection mechanism that adopts both backup path protection and SFC replicas distributed among datacenters to support high availability while reducing total cost.

articleTitle: Three Dimensional Silicon Optical Waveguide Structure Bent by Ion Implantation for Surface Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Titled vertically bent structure with several-micrometers curving radii and a spot size conversion function enables efficient coupling between optical fibers and silicon photonic chips from the surface side with broad spectrum bandwidth and assembly tolerance.

articleTitle: Physical Simulation Environment of The Telecommunications Infrastructure Project (TIP)
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The TIP PSE working group aims at validating the GN-Model in large scale testbeds, provided by facebook, Microsoft, Orange, Telefonica and UTD to use it as foundation for a vendor-independent open-source planning and engineering tool.

articleTitle: Mode-Multiplexed 16-QAM Transmission over 2400-km Large-Effective-Area Depressed-Cladding 3-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 2400 km mode-multiplexed 16-QAM transmission over a low DMGD (27.1 ps/km) and low MDL (1.75 dB) 3-mode fiber link. The large effective-area 3-mode fiber is shown to outperform a standard single-mode fiber for distances up to 4500km.

articleTitle: Non-invasive Distributed Characterization in Phase and Intensity of the Nonlinear Stage of Modulation Instability
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report a novel experimental setup to perform distributed characterization in intensity and phase of the nonlinear stage of modulation instability by means of a non-invasive experimental setup : a heterodyne time domain reflectometer.

articleTitle: Small Footprint Air-gap Multi Fiber Connector with Low Loss and Low Mating Force
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Multi-fiber connector with low mating force (3N) has been developed by applying gap between fibers. The proposed multi-mode/single-mode connector has achieved an average loss of 0.49dB/0.67dB and more than 38dB/60dB return loss without anti-reflection coating.

articleTitle: Frequency-Agile and Filter-Free Wireless Communication Transceiver based on Photonics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A photonics-based tunable RF transceiver able to generate and receive signals, without any RF or optical filter, is proposed. Experimental results with WiFi traffic show flat and good performance over the whole 2-18GHz frequency range.

articleTitle: Multi-material and Multi-functional Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We will present the material science behind thermal drawing that enables us to impart optical fibers with novel architectures and advanced optoelectronic functionalities, as well as propose a new avenue for soft optical devices.

articleTitle: From Spider Webs to a Biomimetic Optical Fibre Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Can we use spider silk threads as natural, biological optical fibre sensors? In this communication, we will see how we can harness the optical properties of spider dragline silk and use it for sensing.

articleTitle: System-Level Demonstration of a Dynamically Reconfigured Burst-Mode Link Using a Nanosecond Si-Photonic Switch
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Using a novel FPGA-based network emulator, microsecond-scale packets with 12.5–20-Gb/s data are generated, routed through a nanosecond Si-photonic switch, and received in a fast-locking burst-mode receiver. Error-free links with <382-ns system-level switching are shown.

articleTitle: Single-λ 112Gbit/s 80-km Transmission of PAM4 Signal with Optical Signal-to-Signal Beat Noise Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel scheme of PAM4 with optical signal-to-signal beat noise cancellation for short reach applications. The required OSNR at FEC threshold is only 27.3 dB for a single-λ 112-Gb/s signal after 80km transmission.

articleTitle: 16×112Gb/s Single-Sideband PAM4 WDM Transmission over 80km SSMF with Kramers-Kronig Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Based on Kramers-Kronig receiver and phase alignment operation, we demonstrate 16-channel 56Gbaud single-sideband PAM4 WDM transmission over 80km SSMF. Single channel 80km transmission of 80Gbaud SSB-PAM4 signal is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 112 Gb/s PAM-4 Amplifier-free Transmission over a Record Reach of 40 km Using 1.3 μm Directly Modulated Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 112 Gb/s single-wavelength single-polarization PAM-4 transmission of a record distance 40 km without any amplification is experimentally demonstrated, enabled by a high-speed and high power directly modulated laser and low complexity equalization.

articleTitle: Fragmentation-Minimized Transponder Upgrading Employing Channel Bandwidth Aligned Slot Allocation in Flexible Grid Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Efficient implementation strategy of new generation channel-speeds is presented where frequency fragmentation is minimized. Substantial improvement in frequency utilization or reduction in fiber number (~15%) is verified for various network conditions and different channel-bandwidth allocations.

articleTitle: Applications of Multimode Fibers for Spectroscopy and Polarization Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A multimode fiber spectrometer is developed with ultrahigh resolution and extreme broad bandwidth. Shaping the input wavefront enables an effective control of output polarization states of a multimode fiber with random polarization and mode coupling.

articleTitle: 10.72Gb/s Visible Light Communication System Based On Single Packaged RGBYC LED Utilizing QAM-DMT Modulation With Hardware Pre-Equalization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrated a 10.72Gb/s wavelengths multiplexing visible light communication system over 1-m indoor free space transmission using a single packaged RGBCY LED with hardware pre-equalization and post equalizer with the bit error rate below 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Pulse-Shaping FIR Filter for Nonlinear Interference Alignment
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We design an irregular pulse-shaping filter to mitigate nonlinear distortion in optical fiber transmission. Our optimized four-dimensional filter allowing nonphysical rotations achieves up to 0.55 dB gain over standard root-raised-cosine (RRC) Nyquist shaping.

articleTitle: K-means Clustering based Multi-Dimensional Quantization Scheme for Digital Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to group highly-correlated neighboring samples into multi-dimensional vectors and adopt k-means clustering for quantization in mobile fronthaul. 30-Gbit/s transmissions have been experimentally demonstrated for up to 40 100MHz LTE channels over 20km fiber.

articleTitle: O2CMF: Experiment-as-a-Service for Agile Fed4Fire Deployment of Programmable NFV
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An open platform over OpenStack for control and management of experiments (O2CMF) for merging and adapting wireless and optical federated testbeds with proper cloud infrastructure is presented. TOSCA-enabled orchestration provides programmability for NFV experiments.

articleTitle: Balancing Probabilistic Shaping and Forward Error Correction for Optimal System Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review probabilistic shaping (PS) and forward error correction (FEC) and study the interplay between the two to jointly maximize the overall information rate.

articleTitle: Remote Abstraction of an Installed Dark Fiber Network using Noise to Signal Ratio
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A dark fiber network was partially abstracted utilizing network monitors, prior information and a single probe channel. Validation employed 13×200Gb·s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> DWDM signals transmitted at the optimum launch power, with measured performance 0.2dB better than abstracted.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Real-Time Add/Drop Operations in DSP-enabled Flexible ROADMs for Converging Fixed and Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Low-cost and versatile DSP-enabled ROADMs with excellent transparency are vital for seamlessly converging fixed and mobile networks, we demonstrate, for the first time, real-time add/drop operations providing switching at sub-wavelength and spectrally-overlapped sub-band levels.

articleTitle: High Performance Self-injection Locked 524 nm Green Laser Diode for High Bitrate Visible Light Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: First demonstration of self-injection locking on 524 nm visible laser diode is presented. Enhancement by ~440 MHz (~30%) in modulation bandwidth, ~7 times reduction in lasing linewidth, and ~10 dB improvement in SMSR is achieved.

articleTitle: Margin Requirement of Disaggregating the DWDM Transport System and Its Consequence on Application Economics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Disaggregation is proposed to reduce network costs and accelerate feature development. This paper evaluates the costs in regional and metro networks associated with disaggregation models, and describes the system design implications of each.

articleTitle: Optical Crosstalk Reduction using Amplified Spontaneous Emission (ASE)
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We employ spectrally filtered amplified spontaneous emission as the signal carrier and matched local oscillator to mitigate optical crosstalk. We demonstrate polarization crosstalk reduction in single-mode fiber transmission and modal crosstalk reduction over multimode fiber.

articleTitle: A 84 Gb/s VSB-PAM8 VCSEL-Based Fiber-FSO Convergence
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 84 Gb/s VSB-PAM8 VCSEL-based fiber-FSO convergence with injection locking scheme and linear equalizer is demonstrated. Such proposed VSB-PAM8 VCSEL-based fiber-FSO convergence is a notable option with good transmission performances for providing high transmission rate.

articleTitle: Secure Transmission using QAM Quantum Noise Stream Cipher with Continuous Variable QKD
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a real-time 70 Gbit/s, 128 QAM quantum noise stream cipher transmission system with a continuous variable quantum key distribution system, which enables encrypted data to be transmitted over 100 km.

articleTitle: Monolithic Dual-polarization Silicon Modulator for 180 Gb/s DMT Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a monolithic dual-polarization modulator based on two silicon Mach-Zehnder modulators and a two-dimensional grating coupler as the dual-polarization output coupler. Data transmission at 180 Gb/s using discrete multi-tone modulation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Leveraging Predictive Analytics to Achieve Knowledge-Defined Orchestration in a Hybrid Optical/Electrical DC Network: Collaborative Forecasting and Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate a hybrid optical/electrical DC network that achieves knowledge-defined orchestration with two collaborative machine learning modules.

articleTitle: Ultra-High-Density MCF Connector Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This talk will present our single-/multi-fiber multi-core fiber (MCF) connectors with the insertion loss of less than 1 dB and physical contact achieved by rotational fiber alignment mechanism and MCF-optimized end face polishing method, respectively.

articleTitle: Fast and Linear Photonic Integrated Microwave Phase-Shifter for 5G Beam-Steering Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An integrated SOI photonic microwave phase-shifter employing optical deinterleaver and reverse-biased pn-junction waveguide for precise, continuous linear phase shift in excess of 360° with fast reconfiguration time below 1 ns for beam-steering applications is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Impact of Fractionally Spatial Super-channel Time-slotted Switch Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We compare fractionally and whole spatial super-channel time-slotted switch architecture designs in terms of network-wide performance of its switching granularity and experimentally demonstrate collision avoidance functionality of SDM based transmission.

articleTitle: Challenges and Advances of Direct Detection Systems for DCI and Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 56-Gb/s NRZ direct detection system is demonstrated with record 15.5-dB (16.2-dB) OSNR sensitivity over 320-km (640-km) SMF. Furthermore, the challenges and recent advances of direct detection systems for DCIs and metro networks are reviewed.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Transport SDN Restoration of Signal-Degraded Connections in Flexi-Grid Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We validate experimentally the integration of a PCE-based T-SDN controller with an OAM Handler to restore signal-degraded flexi-grid connections. A distributed monitoring system is adopted where a RSMA algorithm exploits benefits of elastic optical networks.

articleTitle: Towards IP & Transport Network Transformation Using Standardized Transport NorthBound Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This demo proposes the usage of standardized YANG data models for multi-vendor and multi-layer optical control interoperability. L2/L3 network service establishment will be demonstrated as part of the network transformation strategy for SDN/NFV.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Full-Duplex Bidirectional Data Transmission for Data Center Networks (DCNs) over 2-km Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Fiber using Commercial SFP+ Transceivers and Mode Selective Couplers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-fiber full-duplex bidirectional data transmission link for data center networks (DCNs) using orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing over 2-km OAM fiber. Commercial SFP+ transceivers and mode selective couplers are employed to excite OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1</sub> and OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub> modes carrying 10Gbase-T signals in the downlink and uplink transmission experiments, achieving less than -15.11 dB crosstalk.

articleTitle: Compact Grating Coupler for Higher-order Mode Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An on-chip LP11-TE1 mode grating coupler is experimentally demonstrated by utilizing double-grating structure and a Y-junction. A 0.6 dB improvement of coupling efficiency with a quarter taper length is achieved comparing with conventional grating coupler.

articleTitle: A 14 Gb/s Directly Modulated Hybrid Microring Laser Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The first demonstration of a hybrid-integrated directly modulated microring laser transmitter operating up to 14 Gb/s operation is reported. A CMOS driver with an asymmetric 2-tap feed-forward compensates for the microring laser non-linear dynamics.

articleTitle: Maximizing Availability-Weighted Slice Capacity for Sliceable Wireless-Optical Broadband Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We consider a sliceable wireless-optical broadband access network (WOBAN) to maximize its availability-weighted capacity. For this, Integer Linear Programming (ILP) models and corresponding unavailability-minimized heuristic algorithms are developed. Simulation results show the proposed approaches are efficient to maximize slices' availability-weighted capacity.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Silicon Polarization Beam Splitter with a Short Coupling Length of 0.768 μm
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact silicon polarization beam splitter with a coupling length of 0.768 μm. Lower than 2-dB insertion losses and over 10-dB extinction ratios are achieved over a wavelength range of 60 nm.

articleTitle: 31.2-Tb/s Real Time Bidirectional Transmission of 78×400 Gb/s Interleaved Channels over C Band of One 90-km SMF Span
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit 78×400Gb/s PDM-64QAM 50GHz-spaced channels over one 90-km SSMF span with real time transponder, transporting 31.2 Tb/s with 8 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Photonic Resevoir Computing: A Brain-inspired Approach for Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present our latest results on silicon photonics neuromorphic information processing based on techniques like reservoir computing. We will discuss aspects like scalability, novel architectures for enhanced power efficiency, as well as all-optical readout. Additionally, we will touch upon new machine learning techniques to operate these integrated readouts.

articleTitle: Influence of the Maturity of Technology on the Benefit of 75 GHz-spaced 64 GBaud Channels in WDM Elastic Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We quantify how the benefit of 75 GHz-spaced 64 GBaud channels in WDM core networks depends on both the associated elastic modulation set and the maturity of transponder implementation correlated to the WDM transmission reaches

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Analog IFoF-based Seamless Fiber-wireless Interface for 5G Indoor DAS Supporting 8 FA and 2×2 MIMO Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate analog IFoF-based seamless fiber-wireless interface for 5G indoor DAS that provides down-to 2-% EVM for ambient temperature from -20 to 60 °C with up-to 17 dB power budget, allowing >40 power split-ratio.

articleTitle: Blue-Enhanced Supercontinuum Generation in a Graded-Index Fluorine-Doped Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate blue-enhanced white-light supercontinuum generation in a fluorine-doped parabolic-index multimode fiber. The spectrum expands from 450-2,400nm with excellent spectral flatness and a beam quality factor of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>~1.7 at 1064nm.

articleTitle: Flexible Access System Architecture (FASA)
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: To quickly meet diverse requirements given by emerging new services, we recently proposed a new concept of Flexible Access System Architecture (FASA). The paper reviews our activities on FASA along with disaggregation of time-critical functions.

articleTitle: An IF-Free TDM Fronthaul Aggregating Two 128-MIMO Signals with Enhanced Spectral Efficiency Using Baseband Sample Interleaved Gathering
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel signal-sample-interleaved-gathering scheme in the TDM-based analog fronthaul, where signal aggregation is completely realized by simple DSP without intermediate-frequency (IF)-conversion. Experiment aggregating two 128-MIMO signals verifies that ~25% signal bandwidth is reduced.

articleTitle: When CORD Meets Hub
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Architectures of CORD at the nodal level and Hub at the metro network level are studied. Ways in which they can cooperate, as well as the impact on network operations and economics, are also analyzed.

articleTitle: A Fiberized Metamaterial Device for Ultrafast Control of Coherent Optical Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate selective transmission and absorption of 1-ps pulses, pulse shaping and 1-ps dark pulse generation in a fiber-optic device based on a plasmonic metamaterial, providing an example of all-optical signal processing with THz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuits for NGPON2 Tunable ONUs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: · Overview of NG-PON2 specifications · ONU transmitters - GPON/EPON transmitters - NG-PON2 transmitters for 10G operation · Photonic Integration.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Dispersion Tolerance in Dual-drive MZM-based DAC-less Optical PAM4 Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the chirp characteristics of the two PAM4 generation methods based on dual-drive MZM. Prominent difference in transmission performance between the two methods is experimentally shown for 112Gb/s PAM4 signals when chromatic dispersion exists.

articleTitle: Flexible Silicon Optical Splitters Based on High Order Modes
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Based on the natural splitting in the intensity distribution of high order modes, and using three mode order converters, we demonstrate 0.5/0.5, 0.667/0.333 and 0.75/0.25 Y junction power splitters with high fabrication tolerance.

articleTitle: A Novel Buffering Design and Performance Evaluation of Optical Flow Switch with Smart Scheduling Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel buffering design and performance evaluation of optical flow switch with smart scheduling algorithms are proposed. The input buffer scheduling methods are used for a hybrid switching module or all-optical switching module on the data center. Using the smart input buffer scheduling methods can make the overall exchange throughput further effectively increased. In the hybrid switching module, we propose the offload scheme. The overall switching efficiency will be improved significantly. In the future all-optical switching module, four schemes which include discard scheme, padding scheme, free-riding scheme, and aggregate scheme are proposed and simulated. The results of performance evaluation also show that aggregate scheme has a better switching efficiency.

articleTitle: Low Insertion Loss and Power Efficient 32 × 32 Silicon Photonics Switch with Extremely-High-Δ PLC Connector
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Introduction of optimized structures and a 5.5%-Δ-PLC fiber connector achieved the minimum fiber-to-fiber insertion loss of 9.2 dB and a power consumption of 1.9 W, which are 1/100 and <;1/4 of the previous switch, respectively.

articleTitle: Assigning Counter-Propagating Cores in Multi-Core Fiber Optical Networks to Suppress Inter-Core Crosstalk and Inefficiency due to Bi-directional Traffic Asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the assignment of Multi-Core Fiber (MCF) cores in a counter-propagating way to design an MCF optical network, which suppresses MCF inter-core crosstalk and reduces the capacity inefficiency caused by increasing asymmetry of bi-directional traffic. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Image Transmission Through Multimode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Multimode fibers with a diameter of 100 μm can support more than 100,000 modes. It is possible to use these degrees of freedom to transmit images with the comparable number of degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: An Efficient Nonlinear Equalizer for 40-Gb/s PAM4-PON Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We firstly propose a decision feedback equalizer (DFE) based on a novel nonlinear filter structure for 40-Gb/s PAM4-PON systems. The proposed equalizer achieves similar performance with Volterra DFE at only 21.7% tap numbers.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Service Chain Allocation, VNF instantiation and Metro Network Resource Management Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: In a metro network with VIMs orchestrated by an ETSI-OSM instance, and an optical transport controller, we demonstrate optimized service chain provisioning using the open-source Net2Plan tool with interfaces to OSM (new) and transport controller.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Triple-Mode Controller Recovery with Multiple Integrated Services in SDN
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first completely orchestrated and automatic failure recovery scheme employed various services utilizing the intelligence of SDN. Our proposed three step mechanism can safeguard controllers from failures with a recovery time of 11ms.

articleTitle: Demonstration of NFV for Mobile Edge Computing on an Optically Disaggregated Datacentre in a Box
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This demonstrator showcases the hardware and software integration achieved by the dReDBox project [1] towards realization of a novel architecture using dynamically-reconfigurable optical interconnects to create a flexible, scalable and efficient disaggregated datacentre infrastructure.

articleTitle: On the Scalability of Connectivity Services in a Multi-Operator Orchestrator Sandbox
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The paper investigates the performance of a multi-domain orchestrator (MdO) deployed in a real multi-domain European testbed. Results show how the MdO prototype scales well with the number of domains advertised and connectivity services provisioned.

articleTitle: A Simple, Robust Two-Tone Method to Measure the Dynamic Nonlinear Characteristics of Phase Shifter in Silicon Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A simple and robust method is proposed to measure high-frequency nonlinear phase-voltage relationship of phase shifter in silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator. Experiments show that static and dynamic characteristics are different, and nonlinearity decreases along with frequency.

articleTitle: dRedDbox: Demonstrating Disaggregated Memory in an Optical Data Centre
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper showcases the first experimental demonstration of disaggregated memory using the dRedDbox optical Data Centre architecture. Experimental results demonstrate the 4-tier network scalability and performance of the system at the physical and application layer.

articleTitle: What is the Open Compute Project?
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The Open Compute Project (OCP), a 501(c)(6) organization, is a collaborative global community of technology leaders working together on redesigning hardware technology to efficiently support the growing demands on compute infrastructure. OCP is reimagining hardware, making it more efficient, flexible, and scalable to achieve greater choice, customization and cost savings.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of a Channel Estimation Algorithm for Transmitter-side Digital Pre-compensation Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A channel estimation algorithm is introduced and experimentally validated with a 112-Gbit/s PAM-4 transmission system. The algorithm is shown to estimate overall system bandwidth and demonstrates pre-compensation gains ranging from 0.8 to 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr Solitons in Photonic Chip-based Microresonators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Since their discovery microresonator-based frequency combs have drawn a lot of interest due to their compact form factor and potential for integration. We report on the recent progress regarding dissipative Kerr solitons generated from photonic chip-based microresonators and their use in different fields of application.

articleTitle: Modelling the Impact of SRS on NLI Generation in Commercial Equipment: An Experimental Investigation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate using commercial equipment how performance predictions based on the GN-model may fail on side channels because of SRS, and demonstrate the effectiveness of the GGN-model including distributed SRS effects in NLI estimation.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Characteristics of Injection-locked Lasers Operated at Low Injection Powers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Optical injection locking at -65 dBm input power is demonstrated by using an electrical phase-locked loop and an EDFA pre-amplifier. A slave laser output phase noise below 6 degrees (rms) was confirmed.

articleTitle: Low-crosstalk, Low-power Mach-Zehnder Interferometer Optical Switch Based on III-V/Si Hybrid MOS Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An optical switch with InGaAsP/Si hybrid metal-oxide-semiconductor phase shifter is demonstrated with low crosstalk (−28.6 dB) and low power consumption (1.3 nW) due to the large electron-induced refractive index change and small absorption in InGaAsP.

articleTitle: 266.1-Tbit/s Repeatered Transmission over 90.4-km 6-Mode Fiber Using Dual C+L-Band 6-Mode EDFA
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 6-mode and 580-wavelength multiplexed transmission with an in-line dual C+L-band cladding-pumped few-mode EDFA. A total capacity of 266.1 Tbit/s is achieved over a 90.4-km transmission line at a spectral efficiency of 36.7 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Novel Image Processing Methods for IL Estimation of Field Terminated Connectors
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Investigation of novel methods to estimate insertion loss (IL) in field terminated connector based on radiation pattern variations as a function of the loss.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Multiple Kerr-Frequency-Comb Generation Using Different Lines from Another Kerr Comb Located up to a 50 km Distance
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate multiple Kerr-frequency-comb generation using different lines from another Kerr comb located up to a 50 km distance. The master and generated slave combs are mutually coherent and have a small variance of frequency error.

articleTitle: Regenerator Allocation in Nonlinear Elastic Optical Networks With Random Data Rates
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We optimize the regenerator allocation in nonlinear elastic networks whose traffic demands have random data rates. Compared with previous regenerator allocation algorithm, our method achieves the same blocking probability with 11% less regenerator sites.

articleTitle: Intelligent Remote Sensing Systems Based on Microwave Photonic Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents some recent evolutions of the concept of photonics-based radar. In particular, it reports on the coherent MIMO radar network and on the wideband RF scanning receiver, discussing their potentials.

articleTitle: Silicon-Graphene Hybrid Slot Waveguide with Enhanced Four-Wave Mixing Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An enhanced four-wave mixing in a silicon-graphene hybrid slot waveguide is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The conversion efficiency is -48.8 dB, showing 3.2-dB and 0.5-dB improvements relative to silicon slot waveguide and strip waveguide, respectively.

articleTitle: 4×100G PAM-4 Transmission in Faster-than-Nyquist Systems Incorporating Eigenvalue-Space Precoding
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An eigenvalue-space precoding is proposed to combat narrow-filtering effect in optical PAM-4 systems. Transmissions at 24, 60, and 120 Gbps per wavelength with 6-dB bandwidths of 4, 7.5, and 17.5 GHz are experimentally demonstrated over up-to 30-km SSMF, respectively.

articleTitle: 4096 QAM (72 Gbit/s) Single-Carrier Coherent Optical Transmission with a Potential SE of 15.8 bit/s/Hz in All-Raman Amplified 160 km Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully achieved a 4096 QAM (72 Gbit/s) - 160 km transmission with a potential spectral efficiency of 15.8 bit/s/Hz by employing precise digital polarization demultiplexing and an all-Raman amplified 160 km fiber link.

articleTitle: Long-range, Power-efficient Distributed Flow Measurements Using Chirped-pulse Phase-sensitive Reflectometry
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a technique allowing to perform distributed wind speed measurements over >17 km with <;0.6 km/h uncertainty at only 60 mW/m of power dissipation. Applications in dynamic line rating and catenary monitoring are envisaged.

articleTitle: The Kramers-Kronig Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This presentation reviews the operation principles and various implementations of the Kramers-Kronig (KK) receiver. We show that the KK scheme offers new ways of considering the process of data transmission and reception, with respect to the use of the spectral and polarization degrees of freedom. Some of the recently published experimental demonstrations are reviewed.

articleTitle: Optical Circuit Switching Enabled Reconfigurable HPC Network for Traffic Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a reconfigurable hybrid network architecture using optical circuit switches for HPC systems, and evaluate the performance of different topologies according to different traffic patterns through high throughput and low latency.

articleTitle: DSP-free and Real-time NRZ Transmission of 50Gb/s over 15km SSMF and 64Gb/s Back-to-back with a 1.3μm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate DSP-free and real-time NRZ transmission at 50Gb/s over 15km SSMF, 60Gb/s over 5km SSMF and 64Gb/s back-to-back using a directly modulated 1326nm short cavity VCSEL supported by a SiGe BiCMOS 6-tap feedforward equalizer.

articleTitle: Reduction of the Power Consumption in a WDM/SDM Network by using Cladding Pump Scheme MC-EDFA with Impairment Aware Least Wavelength Bandwidth Routing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We show 39 % reduction of amplification power consumption with cladding pump MC-EDFA using 16-core spectral superchannels over SDM NSFNET16 topology. Impairment aware least wavelength bandwidth routing algorithm further reduces the power consumption by 45%.

articleTitle: 3×4×10-Gb/s MDM-WDM Transmission over 21-km OM3 MMF with OOK Modulation and Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 3×4×10-Gb/s IM-DD MDM-WDM transmission over OM3 MMF is experimentally demonstrated. 3 modes with large Δneff are selectively excited as independent-spatial-channels. Enabled by cascaded low-modal-crosstalk MSCs and wavelength-interleaved scheme, a record distance of 21-km is achieved.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Coherent Quantum Communications with Bayesian Inference
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Laser phase noise limits reach in coherent quantum communications. We experimentally investigate the usefulness of Bayesian inference methods to reduce the impact. An excess noise improvement of 15% is shown, resulting in improved reach and key rate.

articleTitle: Efficient Time-Domain DBP using Random Step-Size and Multi-Band Quantization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Employing step-size randomization and multi-band quantization, we propose a reduced complexity time-domain (TD) digital backpropagation (DBP) and experimentally demonstrate penalty-free operation at an average number of ∼ 4 bits per FIR coefficient.

articleTitle: A Flexible Low-Latency Metro-Access Converged Network Approach Based on Time-Synchronized TWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A flexible time-synchronized TWDM-PON (TS-TWDM-PON) architecture is proposed and implemented for low-latency metro-access communication. Results show that a two-order-of-magnitude reduction in end-to-end delay can be achieved with the new TS-TWDM-PON architecture.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10-Gb/s, 5-GHz Spaced Coherent UDWDM-PON with Digital Signal Processing in Real-Time
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper experimentally demonstrate the real-time field trial of 40×10-Gb/s coherent UDWDM-PON at 5-GHz spacing over 40-km field-installed fiber. The system stability is demonstrated by 8-hour real-time BER measurement with power budget of 29 dB.

articleTitle: Fully Disaggregated ROADM White Box with NETCONF/YANG Control, Telemetry, and Machine Learning-based Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A first demonstration of ROADM White Box augmented with machine learning capabilities is demonstrated. The white box includes various level of disaggregation, NETCONF/YANG control, telemetry and spectrum-based advanced monitoring functionalities.

articleTitle: Networking Benefit of Multi-Subcarrier Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the benefit of multi-subcarrier transceivers on two network topologies. We describe nonlinearities modeling challenges and demonstrate the existence of an optimal subcarrier symbol rate at network-level yielding average OSNR increase up to 0.7dB.

articleTitle: Optical Networks Virtualization and Slicing in the 5G era
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We provide an overview of operationalization and deployment of the different data and control plane technologies used for both Optical Network Virtualization and Network Slicing, which are two key enablers of future 5G networks.

articleTitle: Single-wire DAC/ADC Control and Feedback of Silicon Photonic Ring Resonator Circuits for Wavelength Switching
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a robust and scalable solution for control and feedback of silicon photonic circuits used for optical unicast and multicast. A single-wire DAC and ADC feedback architecture is evaluated with 20Gb/s PAM-4 data streams.

articleTitle: Narrow Linewidth Hybrid InP-TriPleX Photonic Integrated Tunable Laser Based on Silicon Nitride Micro-ring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Detailed characterization of a hybrid integrated tunable laser based on micro-ring resonators shows a tuning range of 50 nm with ∼40 kHz linewidth. The device demonstrates performance comparable with commercial external cavity lasers in 16QAM coherent system.

articleTitle: Data Analytics and Machine learning applied to Transport Layer
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The presentation is organized into two main parts, Part 1: overview on Machine Learning □ Basic concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, bias/variance trade-off, etc.) □ Some algorithms, Linear regression, Neural Networks, K-nearest neighbours.

articleTitle: Design of Submarine “Open” Cables
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Digital coherent receiver and GN model moved submarine transmission systems into the era of “open cables”. This new paradigm leads to consider new parameters to design and characterize open submarine systems independently of the terminal equipment.

articleTitle: On-chip Quantum Optical Frequency Comb Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Integrated optical frequency comb sources, based on nonlinear microring resonators, can be used to generate complex quantum states. In particular, we achieved multi-photon and high-dimensional entangled quantum states, as well as their coherent control.

articleTitle: Digital Pre-compensation Techniques Enabling Cost-effective High-order Modulation Formats Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Digital precompensation complementary to post equalization increases the DSP compensation envelope. Implementable parallel least square of nonlinear bandlimited channel, asymmetric imbalance predistortion of MZM impairments, and quantization noise preshaping minimizing DAC resolution requirement are presented.

articleTitle: Edge Coupling Integrated Optics Packaging Concept Using Liquid Crystal Element
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Many packaging approaches for integrated optics cannot meet the industry demand. We propose a post-assembly correction concept, using a liquid crystal element compatible with small form-factor pluggable modules, which may significantly reduce costs.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of SDN-controlled Variable-rate Fronthaul for Converged LTE-over-PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce the concept of variable-rate fronthaul and provide experimental validation over PONs. Our SDN controller dynamically modifies the wireless cell bandwidth depending on load, thus varying the fronthaul rate with sub-second end-to-end reconfiguration times.

articleTitle: Photonic Sampling of Broadband QAM Microwave Signals Exploiting Interleaved Optical Nyquist Pulses
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We performed photonic sampling of 6 Gbaud 16-QAM signals at 20 GHz sampling frequency by interleaving and time-aligning two 10 GHz Nyquist optical sampling pulse trains using a SMF as the dispersive medium.

articleTitle: High Speed Modulator Based on Electro-optic Polymer Infiltrated Subwavelength Grating Waveguide Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a high-speed modulator based on electro-optic polymer infiltrated subwavelength grating waveguide ring resonator. A 3-dB small signal modulation bandwidth of 41.36 GHz has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Scaling Optical Networking Technologies for Next Generation SDM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 1. Network traffic growth remains strong Sold WDM transponder capacity scales at ~45% Scaling is widely supported by compute, storage, access scaling Optical transport is significantly falling behind → Worrisome scaling disparities (“Capacity Crunch”) 2. Parallelism is mandatory log(SNR) scaling vs. linear (pre-log) multiplexing gains 3. By 2025 we will need 10T interfaces in 1P systems Massively integrated (coherent) systems: B × M × log(SNR) Scaling using WDM × SDM 4. Integration, integration, integration Holistic view of client and line interfaces integrated onto digital CMOS chips “Fiber-in-fiber-out” (FIFO) all-in-one transport processor solutions.

articleTitle: Stretchable Multi-function Fiber Sensor for Tension, Bending and Torsion Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a stretchable fiber-optic sensor by embedding a sinusoidal-structured fiber Bragg grating in a silicone sheet at an off-center position, which uniquely enables 30% of elongation and facilitates tension, torsion direction, and bending measurement.

articleTitle: Real-Time Demonstration of Polarization-Multiplexed PAM using a Compact Silicon Photonics Device
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate doubling capacity per wavelength using polarization-multiplexed PAM and direct-detection polarization recovery using a compact silicon photonic integrated device. Moreover, we present fundamental theoretical curves for PM-PAM performance.

articleTitle: Transmission in 125-km SMF with 3.9 bit/s/Hz Spectral Efficiency Using a Single-drive MZM and a Direct-detection Kramers-Kronig Receiver without Optical CD Compensation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate single channel transmission in 125-km SMF of 59 Gbit/s in a 15 GHz optical bandwidth (3.9 bit/s/Hz gross spectral efficiency) using a single-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator and Kramers-Kronig detection without optical chromatic dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Network Architecture in the Era of Integrated Optics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Disparities in reach and cost between electrical and optical ports have important implications for network architecture. We quantify network cost, capturing the tradeoffs of pizzabox versus chassis switches and the potential impact of integrated optics.

articleTitle: Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) of Light in Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Light carries spin (polarization) and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We review recent work on the stable propagation and nonlinear properties of such states in fibers, which have spawned applications ranging from telecommunications to biomedical imaging.

articleTitle: Record-High 17.3-bit/s/Hz Spectral Efficiency Transmission over 50 km Using Probabilistically Shaped PDM 4096-QAM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of a 10-subcarrier superchannel with a record-high intra-channel spectral efficiency of 17.3 bit/s/Hz over 50-km backward Raman amplified Corning® Vascade® EX2000 fiber using 3-GBd probabilistically shaped PDM 4096-QAM.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Inter-Dimensional Adaptive Diversity Combining and Repetition Coding in Converged MMW/FSO Links for 5G and beyond Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We firstly introduce inter-dimensional adaptive-diversity-combining-technique in fiber-wireless fronthaul. By adaptively combining symbols from millimeter-wave and free-space-optics links in time/frequency domain and applying repetition coding, we experimentally attained better tunability in power margins with improved reliability.

articleTitle: FEC-assisted Perturbation-based Nonlinear Compensation for WDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A FEC-assisted iterative perturbation-based nonlinear post-compensation scheme is proposed and experimentally investigated. Improved compensation performance is observed for a 5×WDM-DP 32-GBd dispersion-uncompensated transmission over 3500 and 840 km for 16QAM and 64QAM, respectively.

articleTitle: Universal Fibers for Both Single-mode and Multimode Transmissions in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Universal fiber is a single medium that can support both multimode and single-mode transmission. We present the fiber properties and system performance at 100G and discuss the benefit of using it in data center.

articleTitle: Improved Link Budget (35 dB) of 2×25 Gb/s WDM/TDM-PON by Using Crosstalk-free SOA and FEC
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a link budget improved 2×25 Gb/s WDM/TDM-PON by using O-band SOA with an assist light and FEC. When the assist light is used to the SOA, gain-saturation induced crosstalk of SOA was successfully mitigated. 50G-Ethernet PON traffic was transmitted over 20-km reach and 256-split.

articleTitle: Combining Probabilistic Shaping and Nonlinear Mitigation: Potential Gains and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally compare different options for transmission at 200G net bit-rate and demonstrate that the benefits of probabilistic shaping and nonlinear mitigation via SRO and/or DBP can be effectively combined to enable propagation reach enhancement of > 40%.

articleTitle: Data-analytics-based Optical Performance Monitoring Technique for Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that a convolutional neural network (CNN) can acquire an accurate OSNR estimation functionality from asynchronously sampled data right after intradyne coherent detection, while the feature selection before the CNN can be omitted.

articleTitle: Coarse and Fine Continuously Tunable Optical Delay Using the Time-of-flight in Fiber Bragg Gratings and Wavelength Conversion
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We use the time-of-flight in arrayed, channelized and chirped fiber Bragg gratings along with wavelength conversion in PPLN waveguides to build continuously coarse- and fine-tunable delay line. More than 20 ns continues tuning range is achieved with less-than-0.6dB OSNR penalty for a 10 Gbaud QPSK signal.

articleTitle: High Throughput Bandwidth Characterization of Silicon Photonic Modulators using Offset Frequency Combs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
