abstract: We develop a low complexity, high-throughput testing technique for concurrently characterizing the bandwidths of multiple in-series modulators with independent frequency combs. The approach is demonstrated on two serial modulators at 9.2 GHz and 15.5 GHz.

articleTitle: 50-Gb/s TDM-PON Based on 10G-Class Devices by Optics-simplified DSP
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 50-Gb/s PAM-4 TDM-PON over 25-km SSMF based on DML and APD with 6-GHz 3-dB bandwidth in O-band. Dispersion-supported optical equalization is used to reduce the complexity of FFE and Volterra algorithms.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Inter-core Switching within Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We achieved a reconfigurable inter-core signal switching using directional bending of long period grating in multicore fibers. Wavelength selective switching of 6×224 Gb/s OFDM signals in 3 cores is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Modulator based on Coupled Bragg Grating Resonators used as Phase Shifters
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Bragg gratings with phase-shifts are inserted in a Mach-Zehnder modulator to enhance phase modulation, reduce device length and improve efficiency (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>×L=0.28 Vcm). Simulations show 3 nm optical bandwidth corresponding to 50 K operating temperature range.

articleTitle: Real-time Spectrum Surveillance in Filterless Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A monitoring system exploiting data analytics and cost-effective optical spectrum analyzers with under 1.2GHz resolution is proposed. Its performance is demonstrated in a filterless network experimental test-bed. The system enables prompt action before lightpath disruption.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 53.125 Gb/s, CWDM, PAM-4, Directly Modulated Laser Transmission over 20 km SMF
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 20 km, 53.125 Gb/s, CWDM, O-band, PAM-4 DML transmission is demonstrated. -11 dBm outer OMA at KP-4 FEC threshold up to 70 °C TOSA case temperature is measured using a TO ROSA packaged using 26 GHz PIN PD, linear TIA and self-adaptive DSP.

articleTitle: Photonic Integration for Quantum Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Integrated photonics shows promise as a cost-effective, yet high performance, device platform for generating, manipulating and detecting single or entangled photons, with potential applications in secure communications, precision sensors and quantum interconnects.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a 12.5 Gb/s Indoor Optical Wireless Communication System with Silicon Integrated Photonic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A high-speed indoor infrared optical wireless communication system using silicon photonics integrated beam steering circuit is experimentally demonstrated. Results show that up to 12.5 Gb/s error-free operation is achieved through over 140 cm free-space distance.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Tunable Filter with Large Bandwidth and Wavelength Tuning Range
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-multiple-microring-based Vernier optical filter with both large bandwidth and wavelength tuning range. The bandwidth can be tuned from 0.3 nm to 1.2 nm. The wavelength tuning range can cover C-band.

articleTitle: Maximum Submarine Cable Capacity Analysis with C-band, C+L-band, and Multicore Fiber C-band
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The maximum capacity of fixed voltage submarine cables is analyzed using single-core fibers with C- and C+L-band systems, and multi-core fibers (MCFs) with C-band transmission. Extra losses for C+L and MCFs limit their relative capacity.

articleTitle: Single-Laser Differential Phase Shift Transmitter for Small Form-Factor Quantum Key Distribution Optics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A cost-effective QKD transmitter based on a phase-modulated laser with integrated pulse carving is experimentally demonstrated. A raw key rate of 4.5kb/s at 2.65% quantum bit error ratio is obtained after 27 km fiber transmission.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s DAC-less and DSP-free Transmitters using GeSi EAMs for Short-Reach Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present single-lane 100-Gb/s NRZ, electrical duobinary and PAM-4 transmitters using silicon photonics GeSi electro-absorption modulators. No DSP, DAC or traveling-wave structures are required, enabling compact and low-power transceivers for data center interconnects.

articleTitle: Service Function-Oriented Topology Aggregation in Multi-Domain Inter-DC Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A service function-oriented topology aggregation is proposed, based on which a routing and resource assignment algorithm is designed for service function chain construction in multidomain optical networks. Simulation results show it can achieve high efficiency.

articleTitle: Physical-contact 256-core MPO Connector with Flat Polished Multi-core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Physical contact of all the cores of ultra-high-density 256-core MPO connectors with 32 strands of 8-core fibers was achieved with a 22-N mating force by polishing method realizing flat fiber facets and small fiber-protrusion difference.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic True-Time Delay Beamformer for a Ka-band Phased Array Antenna Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonic 4×1 TTD beamformer operated in real-time. Beamforming of a 1 Gb/s QPSK signal carried at 28 GHz was validated by a fourfold improvement in output amplitude and EVM.

articleTitle: Record High Bandwidth Integrated Graphene Photodetectors for Communication Beyond 180 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the fastest silicon waveguide integrated photodetectors with a bandwidth larger than 128 GHz for ultrafast optical communication. The photodetectors are based on CVD graphene that is compatible to wafer scale production methods.

articleTitle: Automated Calibration of Balanced Control to Optimize Performance of Silicon Photonic Switch Fabrics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Highly-efficient, fabric-wide calibration of balanced control for optical switch fabrics without built-in power-detectors is first realized with fully-automated implementation. This technique co-optimizes thermo-optic and electro-optic phase elements, correcting phase-error and power-imbalance simultaneously for optimized performance.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Silicon Photonics Phase Modulator using Graphene
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Compact graphene-silicon phase-shifter with 0.28V·cm modulation efficiency at 1550nm is reported. The 2V MZ modulator has been tested over 50km SMF link at 10Gb/s and the chirped EA modulator over 100km SMF fiber link.

articleTitle: > 10 dB SNR Enhancement in Distributed Acoustic Sensors through First Order Phase Noise Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The performance of Rayleigh-based distributed acoustic sensors (DAS) is strongly dependent on the coherence of the laser source. We present a simple methodology to reduce the impact of the laser phase noise in chirped-pulse DAS.

articleTitle: Microsecond Optical Switching Network of Processor SoCs with Optical I/O
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an OCS network with microsecond switching time between processors featuring monolithic ring-resonator-based WDM-compatible optical I/Os. This solution can solve EPS scalability challenge and enable novel architectures for emerging disaggregated and heterogeneous data-centers and HPC.

articleTitle: Stable Torsion Sensor with Tunable Sensitivity and Rotation Direction Discrimination Based on a tapered Trench-Assisted Multi Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A tapered Trench-Assisted Multi Core Fiber (TA-MCF) is firstly proposed and experimentally demonstrated for torsion sensing. The rotation direction can be discriminated and the torsion sensitivity is tunable up to 1.1 nm/°.

articleTitle: Integrated, Scalable and Reconfigurable Silicon Photonics Based Optical Switch for Colorless, Directionless and Contentionless Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a BCD8sP electronic-photonic integrated device for low cost, low power, and mass-manufacturable optical switching. Our network on-chip has one thousand photonic components, each driven by a dedicated electronic control circuit. The architecture implements a transponder aggregator scheme that manages 12 200GHz-spaced wavelengths in 4 different directions and 8 add/drop ports. The 3D integration of the photonic and the electronic chips allows the complete system reconfiguration at microsecond regime. The packaged device shows a total insertion loss of −22dB, including input and output coupling, and a channel isolation better than 35dB, in a device with a chip area of less than 1cm2.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient and Highly Resilient Grouped Routing Network Enhanced with Optical Performance Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a spectrally efficient and highly resilient grouped-routing optical network, whose Q-factor margin is precisely controlled with optical performance monitoring. Its effectiveness is confirmed via network analysis and transmission experiments on 200-Gbps DP-16QAM signals.

articleTitle: Phase Purity Measurement of Ultra-Broadband Orbital Angular Momentum Mode Excited by Meta-Facet Few-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We design and fabricate metasurface on the facet of few-mode fiber (FMF). Ultra-broadband orbital angular momentum modes (OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1</sub> and OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub>) are excited in the fiber and the phase purity from 1480-1640 nm is measured through one interferogram image.

articleTitle: Study of Dispersion Compensating Multimode Fiber for Future VCSEL PAM-4 Channels at Data Rates over 100 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We study the effects of dispersion compensating multimode fiber for data rates exceeding 100 GB/s using 4-level pulse amplitude modulation (PAM-4). Performances of different data rates, fibers, and VCSEL bias currents are compared.

articleTitle: High Optical Budget PtP DWDM System in Overlay with CWDM for Mobile Xhaul with Remote Wavelength Tuning and Monitoring in Tunable SFPs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally achieved 33dB optical budget with real time monitoring and wavelength tuning within a DWDM system in a fronthaul architecture. Compatibility with commercial RAT and remote control of the Tunable-SFPs are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fundamentals and Applications of Optical Parametric Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Contributions from many current and former PhD students, post-docs, and colleagues: C. Lundström, S. Olsson, J. Hansryd, M. Westlund, H. Sunnerud, M. Sköld, P. Kylemark, T. Torounidis, R. Kakarla, K. Vijayan, H. Eliasson, A. Lorences-Riesgo, B. Corcoran, R. Malik, Z. Tong, E. Nazemosadat, Ben Foo, and M. Karlsson.

articleTitle: Doubly Differential Two-level 8PSK for Enabling Optical Packet Switching in Coherent Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that a doubly differential two-level 8 phase shift keying (PSK) modulation format can be used to reduce the waiting time in packet switched spectrally efficient coherent systems due to high frequency offset tolerance.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Characterization of a Mode-Locked Quantum-Dot Coherent Optical Frequency Comb Source Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The amplitude fluctuations and correlation times of the two contributions to the phase noise of a quantum-dot optical frequency comb source laser are characterized using simultaneously recovered phase noise trajectories for pairs of comb lines.

articleTitle: Spectrum-efficient 50-Gbps Long-Range Optical Access over 85-km SSMF via DML Using Windowed OFDM Supporting Quasi-Gapless Asynchronous Multiband Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a long-range optical access network using windowed OFDM, providing 50.22-Gbps data rate over 85-km SSMF transmission via DML. In multiband transmission, windowed OFDM has achieved 153% bandwidth gain with suppressed out-of-band leakage.

articleTitle: A 10Gb/s All-Optical Match-line for optical Content Addressable Memory (CAM) Rows
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first all-optical match-line for a two Optical CAM-cell-based address look-up row, using wavelength encoding and an AWG-multiplexer. Error-free 2-bit search memory operation at 10Gb/s is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Block-Wise Time Domain Large Signal Model of Carrier-Depletion Mach-Zehnder Silicon Photonic Modulators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Time domain large signal model operating in block signal mode is proposed for traveling-wave silicon photonic (SiPh) modulators based on carrier depletion. The underlying theory, implantation algorithm details, and waveform level simulation results are summarized.

articleTitle: Applying Data Visualization for Failure Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Data visualization is applied to BER measures in a bigdata repository. Bubble charts are produced to identify lightpaths with increasing BER and spectrum color maps are then used to identify the most likely degraded link.

articleTitle: Symmetric lithium-niobate waveguide fabricated by bonding for mode-division-multiplexing applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricate a symmetric lithium-niobate waveguide that supports six fiber-compatible spatial modes by a bonding process and demonstrate the feasibility of forming vertical directional couplers with such a waveguide for fiber-based mode-division-multiplexing applications.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Real-Time 400G Single-Carrier Ultra-Efficient 1.2Tb/s Superchannel over Large Aeff Ultra-Low Loss Terrestrial Fiber of 150km Single Span and 250km (2×125km Spans) Using only EDFA Amplification
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated real-time 400G (64GBaud DP-16QAM) single-carrier ultra-efficient 1.2Tb/s superchannel (6.25bit/s/Hz) over new ultra-low loss large Aeff terrestrial fiber with long term error-free performance over 150km single-span and 250km (2 spans) using only EDFAs.

articleTitle: Use Cases for Optical Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present results from trials in three promising uses cases for optical wireless communication (OWC): Mobile backhaul, industrial wireless, and indoor Li-Fi. We point out specific requirements and illustrate performance through measurements in typical scenarios.

articleTitle: Fully Flexible Filtering Element on SOI with 7–80 GHz bandwidth tunability and full FSR tuning
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a fully tunable Silicon-on-Insulator filtering element, relying on a 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order micro ring resonator equipped with three variable optical couplers. Experimental results revealed bandwidth tunability between 7-80 GHz and full FSR tuning.

articleTitle: 56 Gb/s DAC-less and DSP-free PAM-4 Using A Silicon Photonic Dual-drive Michelson Interferometric Modulator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a silicon photonic dual-drive Michelson interferometric modulator for DAC-less and DSP-free PAM-4 signal generation. 56 Gb/s PAM-4 transmission over 2 km of SSMF is successfully achieved, with a BER below HD FEC threshold.

articleTitle: 96-Gbaud PDM-8QAM Single Channel Transmission over 9,600 km by Nonlinear Tolerance Enhancement using PPLN-based Optical Phase Conjugation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 96-Gbaud PDM-8QAM single carrier long-haul transmission is demonstrated employing polarization-diverse PPLN-based optical phase conjugator which increased the optimal fiber input power by 4dB and extends the transmission distance from 7,040 km to 9,600km.

articleTitle: Assessment of Integrated Ge Franz-Keldysh Modulator for Discrete Multi-Tone Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We measure the second order and third order spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR) of an integrated germanium Franz-Keldysh modulator and assess the performance of the modulator for discrete multi-tone (DMT) modulation without any pre-equalization.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Beam Steering Enabled by Photonics & Plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Photonics and plasmonics offer unique opportunities to realize ultrafast millimeter wave beam steering concepts relying on phased array antennas. We discuss recent advances and experiments demonstrating settling times in the order of 10s of ps.

articleTitle: Driver-Less Sub 1 Vpp Operation of a Plasmonic-Organic Hybrid Modulator at 100 GBd NRZ
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate driver-less 100 GBd operation of a plasmonic intensity modulator. Drive voltages below 1V lead to low power consumption of 2.84 fJ/bit for 100 Gbit/s with a direct detected BER below the HD-FEC limit.

articleTitle: Low Latency Networks: Future Service Level Use Cases and Requirements
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The Tactile Internet with mobile and machine-to-machine (M2M) applications, along with long-standing financial and storage applications, are driving optical services to provide higher bandwidth, higher availability, and increasingly lower latency.

articleTitle: Single-Sideband Thin Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN™) Electro-optic Modulators for RF over Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A high speed thin film lithium niobate modulator device is integrated with a Bragg grating for in situ sideband filtering. The configuration has potential for high efficiency linear intensity modulation at bandwidths exceeding 70 GHz.

articleTitle: 32-Port 5.5%-Δ Silica-Based Connecting Device for Low-Loss Coupling between SMFs and Silicon Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report a low-loss connecting technique between silicon waveguides and standard single-mode fibers using a unique extremely-high-Δ silica-based PLC. 32-port coupling with coupling losses of 1.4~1.6 dB/facet and pitch conversion has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneously Integrated III-V/Si Colliding Pulse Mode-locked Laser with On-chip Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated O-band III-V/Si colliding pulse mode-locked laser with tunable on-chip external feedback for pulse stabilization. The 3-dB RF linewidth is 13.8 kHz, a reduction by a factor of 2.9× with the adjustment of external feedback.

articleTitle: Single-Lane 100Gb/s 4-PAM Transmission over 80km SSMF Based on K-K scheme and Integrated 10G TOSA
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 10G tunable InP TOSA based 100G 4-PAM transmission over 80 km SSMF employing Kramers-Kronig receiving technologies, nonlinear compensation algorithm and partial response signaling. The required OSNR of 32.5 dB at the 7% overhead FEC limit (BER=4.×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>) was achieved.

articleTitle: PANDA-Type Elliptical-Core Multi-Mode Fiber with Fully Lifted Eigenmodes for Low-Crosstalk Direct Fiber Vector Eigenmode Space-Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a PANDA-type elliptical-core multi-mode fiber featuring an elliptical core and two symmetrical circular stress-applying parts. With proper fiber geometric dimension and doping concentration, the designed fiber is able to support 24 fully lifted eigenmodes with minimum effective index difference between adjacent modes larger than 1.30×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> over the whole C+L band.

articleTitle: 1-Tb/s Photonics-aided Vector Millimeter-Wave Signal Wireless Delivery at D-Band
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate wireless transmission of D-band 64QAM mm-wave signals over 3.1-m distance with a total bit rate of 1.056Tb/s. The employment of probabilistic-constellation-shaping, Nyquist-shaping, photonics-aided technology and look-up-table significantly improves mm-wave wireless transmission capacity and system performance.

articleTitle: High-speed Two-dimensional Photodetector Array for 4-WDM 25-Gbaud FSO Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a newly developed 32-pixel high-speed 2D photodetector array operated at up to 39 Gbaud, and its application for WDM FSO communications. 4-WDM 25-Gbaud FSO parallel beams could be directly detected by the 2D-PDA.

articleTitle: Graded-index Seven-core Fiber Optimized for High Density and Ultra-wideband Parallel Transmission Application
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose graded-index seven-core fiber optimized for high density and ultra-wideband parallel transmission application. We demonstrated both 1 km-propagation at 850 nm and 12.4 km-propagation at 1310 nm simultaneously at a data rate of 7×10-Gb/s.

articleTitle: Using Raman Gain to Offset Excess Losses of an Intelligent Optical Distribution Network in a TWDM PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We use bi-directional distributed Raman amplification to offset the excess losses of an intelligent splitter module. We demonstrate this technique in a 42-km, 1:32 split, TWDM PON.

articleTitle: Residual Non-Linear Phase Noise in Probabilistically Shaped 64-QAM Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We show that the performance penalty for probabilistically-shaped constellations induced by residual non-linear phase noise after standard CPE is significantly higher in low-symbol rate systems, canceling the potential gain achievable through symbol rate optimization.

articleTitle: Design and Deployment of Optical White Box
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: White box solutions have been deployed inside data centers for many years. Like SDN this technological approach is spilling into the transmission world. Let's review current industry status and explore the future of this exciting space.

articleTitle: Fiber-Optic Frequency Shifting of THz-Range WDM Signal Using Orthogonal Pump-Signal Polarization Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a nonlinear fiber-based optical frequency shifter using two CW pumps orthogonally polarized to signals and demonstrate THz-range error-free frequency shifting of 1.6-Tb/s DP-16QAM WDM signal without guard-band midway through 160 km transmission.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics and Plasmonics towards Network-on-Chip Functionalities for Disaggregated Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The main challenges in today's landscape of chip-scale computational settings are overviewed, discussing about the potential of silicon photonics and plasmonics to yield Network-on-Chip technologies and architectures capable of overcoming the limitations of current infrastructures.

articleTitle: Modeling and Design Aspects of a Monolithically Integrated Optoelectronic Chip enabling 64Gbaud Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the modeling of silicon photonic IQ-modulators with monolithically co-integrated BiCMOS segmented drivers. The structure is evaluated for coherent inter-DCI applications with symbol rates up to 64GBd and modulation formats up to DP-64QAM.

articleTitle: Optimized Differential Detection-Based Optical Carrier Recovery for Intradyne PSK Receivers in udWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present an optical carrier recovery based on differential detection that reduces required DSP hardware resources. Results show −55dBm sensitivity for BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> and high tolerance against fast LO frequency dithering, with DPSK data at 1.25Gbps.

articleTitle: Automatic Tuning of Microring-Based Hitless Reconfigurable Add-Drop Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Exploiting a novel channel labeling scheme, we demonstrate automated tuning and locking of a hitless silicon microring-resonator filter. Hitless tuning with more than 30 dB isolation is achieved, enabling application in add-drop reconfigurable architectures.

articleTitle: Cladding-Rods-Assisted Depressed-Core 9-LP-Mode Fiber with Improved Modal Spacing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report the design of a cladding-rods-assisted depressed-core 9-LP-mode fiber featuring more equally spaced modal effective indices, suitable for high-spatial-density uncoupled mode-division-multiplexing systems. It exhibits improved modal spacing (≥1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>) and large modal effective areas (≥127 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Comparison of Nonlinearity Tolerance of Modulation Formats for Subcarrier Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the use of 4D constant modulus modulation format combined with subcarrier modulation. Compared to the star-8QAM format, the proposed format has an improved performance gain from reducing the baud rate down to 1 GBd.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable 3-Channel All-Optical MIMO Circuit on Silicon Based on Multi-Plane Light Conversion
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate reconfigurable all-optical MIMO demultiplexing on a compact silicon chip. 3-mode demultiplexing is realized experimentally with wavelength-dependent loss less than 3 dB and modal crosstalk less than −13 dB over 26-nm optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex and Scalable MIMO Fiber-Wireless Seamless System in W-Band for Future Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a scalable fiber-wireless system in W-band for the simultaneous transmission of MIMO signals in both downlink and uplink directions. Satisfactory performance is confirmed for 2 × 2 MIMO OFDM and LTE-A signals in both directions.

articleTitle: An Integrated Silicon Bragg Grating Filter without Circulator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated an integrated silicon Bragg grating filter with an equivalent circulator. The reflected power by the Bragg grating will not be reflected to the launched port, but be dropped at a third port.

articleTitle: 230 Mbit/s Real-Time Optical Wireless Transmission in Non-Directed Line-Of-Sight Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally realized a real-time optical wireless transmission in Non-directed Line-of-Sight (i.e. without lenses), by a low-cost infrared LED and FPGA-based DMT processing. We achieve from 230 to 100 Mbit/s over a 3 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> area.

articleTitle: OFC 2018: AT&T's PON & Edge Compute Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 1 Enable fixed access technologies to support low latency, Multi-Gbps broadband. 2 Develop and deploy a flexible fiber network that allows for quicker adaptability when deploying new technologies. 3 Evolve the network by creating open platform designs to allow for greater flexibility and quicker time to market.

articleTitle: Enabling 5G Services in PON with a Novel Smart Edge Based on SiP MRM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel passive optical network (PON) smart edge supporting 5G services by exploiting silicon photonic (SiP) microring modulators (MRM) with advantages of compactness, low-cost, low power and colorless operation. We validate the proposal experimentally.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of 2-μm On-chip Two-mode Division Multiplexing Using Tapered Directional Coupler-based Mode(de)multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate two-mode division multiplexing with directly modulated 5-Gbit/s signals on an SOI platform at the 2 μm wavelength region. The on-chip device exhibits low mode crosstalk and wide bandwidth over the wave band.

articleTitle: Novel In-Service OSNR Monitoring Method for Reconfigurable Coherent Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel in-service OSNR monitoring technique is experimentally validated on tightly filtered polarization-multiplexed signals for a range of network operating conditions and reconfigurations. The results demonstrate sufficient accuracy and robustness for measurements in practical networks.

articleTitle: An InAs/InP quantum Dot C-band Coherent Comb Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We have developed InAs/InP quantum-dot 34.462-GHz C-band coherent comb laser modules with low relative intensity and phase noises over its filtered 45 channels, which can be used for data center and coherent communication systems.

articleTitle: 100km Quasi-lossless Fiber-optic Transmission with a Novel Cascaded Random Raman Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Ultra-long distance (100km) quasi-lossless fiber-optic transmission is experimentally performed by using the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order Raman amplification pumped by a novel 1280nm cascaded random Raman fiber laser, which is the longest quasi-lossless transmission system reported to date.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Silicon Photonic Switch
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A packaged and fully operational 32×32 silicon photonic switch chip having 448 switch cells and 1856 crossings is demonstrated. Development of low loss optical components is essential to the operation of complex Mach-Zehnder switch fabrics.

articleTitle: Compact Silicon Microring Modulator with Tunable Extinction Ratio and Wide FSR
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A tunable two-point coupling scheme for a microring modulator on a silicon-on-insulator platform, that achieves a > 30 dB extinction ratio while maintaining a large (19.23 nm) free spectral range, is presented.

articleTitle: Fully-Loaded and Cascaded Operation of Polarization-Diversity 8 × 8 Silicon Photonics Optical Switch with 11-ch × 32/44-Gbaud DP-16QAM WDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate eleven-channel, 32/44-Gbaud DP-16QAM WDM transmission through a polarization-insensitive 8×8 silicon photonics switch with all ports cyclically connected, corresponding to 35.2-Tb/s throughput-per-switch, eight-stage cascaded operation. The wall-plug energy efficiency of the switch was 0.51pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Fully Disaggregated White Box Including Different Types of Transponders and Monitors, Controlled by NETCONF and YANG
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a fully disaggregated white box composed of two different types of transponders, monitors (including filtering effect parameters), add-drop multiplexers, and switches. NETCONF and YANG control the hardware.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Evaluations of 400G Optical Interconnect Implementations for Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The cost evolution and power consumption of different 400G transceivers are modeled and the benefits of constructing and scaling the Facebook's datacenter Fabric utilizing different technologies is presented through comparative cost and power consumption analysis.

articleTitle: Observation of Guided Acoustic-Wave Brillouin Scattering and its Digital Compensation in Coherent QAM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Guided acoustic-wave Brillouin scattering (GAWBS) noise was observed in a digital coherent QAM transmission, which deteriorated the transmission performance. A new digital signal processing method is presented that compensates for the GAWBS noise.

articleTitle: Optical Amplification in Extended Wavelength Windows
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial aims to highlight latest results in the field of bismuth-doped fiber amplifiers for extended (outside Er bands) wavelength windows within telecom fiber transparency range. Also latest results on Er-Bi-hybrid amplifier will be reviewed. Fundamental and technical challenges toward the development of efficient amplifiers on bismuth fibers are discussed.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multiband WSN, WLAN, LTE-A, and Gb/s 4-PAM Signals Transmission over 50 m 1 mm Core Diameter POF for Home Area Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Four Wireless-Sensors-Network channels were transmitted over 50m GI-POF and 12m wireless together with a WLAN signal, 9 64-QAM LTE-A bands with reduced PAPR, and 1.66Gb/s 4-PAM baseband signal for multi-standard wired-wireless smart-home and in-home networks.

articleTitle: Optical Add-Drop Filter based on Raman-Assisted Phase-Sensitive Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical add-drop filter based on Raman-assisted phase-sensitive amplifiers. Bit error rate measurements with multi-channel signals in QPSK and 16-QAM formats reveal its enhanced selectivity over conventional phase-sensitive amplifiers.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient SSB signals for W-band Links Enabled by Kramers-Kronig Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a radio-over-fiber link based on the Kramers-Kronig receiver for the first time. Using this technique, we recover an 11 GBd single sideband signal with a net spectral efficiency of 3.4 (bit/s)/Hz at W-band.

articleTitle: Autonomous Dynamic Bandwidth Steering with Silicon Photonic-Based Wavelength and Spatial Switching for Datacom Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present an autonomous SDN network architecture that leverages the spatial and wavelength switching capabilities of silicon photonics microring-based circuits for self-adaptive bandwidth steering. These functionalities are seamlessly integrated and demonstrated in a datacom testbed.

articleTitle: Deployed Systems for Quantum Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Quantum communication, based on the quantum physics, can provide information theoretical security. The gap between ideal devices and realistic setups, however, has raised various security loopholes, which have become the targets of many attacks and obstacles against its deployment and applications. I shall review the various efforts towards secure QKD system with practical devices over the society. Then I shall provide details about the deployed quantum communication systems in China, including metropolitan, backbone and satellite based international network, the technology challenging, the performance and an outlook.

articleTitle: Real-time 10Gbps Polarization Independent Quasicoherent Receiver for NG-PON2 Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A real-time 10Gbps polarization independent quasicoherent receiver for NG-PON2 access networks is proposed and experimentally validated. The sensitivity of this receiver is -33dBm and making feasible a 35dB power budget (required for E2 class).

articleTitle: LCoS-based Access Node for Bidirectional Optical Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An LCoS-based access node using optical fibers as the transmitter and receiver to extend the high-speed data transmission from NG-PON 2 to indoor home area network through optical wireless communications without O/E/O conversions is reported.

articleTitle: Coordinating Multi-access Edge Computing with Mobile Fronthaul for Optimizing 5G End-to-End Latency
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: In 5G, latency-sensitive traffic might be processed directly at central-offices by Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) right after being transported through Mobile Fronthaul (MFH). We investigate how to optimize end-to-end latency by coordinating MEC with MFH.

articleTitle: Novel Low-Complexity Fully-Blind Density-Centroid — Tracking Equalizer for 64-QAM Coherent Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a low-complexity non-data-aided density-centroid-tracking equalizer to improve the performance of 64-QAM coherent optical communication system. We experimentally demonstrated it over 80-km single mode fiber transmission and observed approximately 2-dB power penalty improvement.

articleTitle: Single Wavelength 480 Gb/s Direct Detection Transmission Over 80 km SSMF Enabled by Stokes Vector Receiver and Reduced-Complexity SSBI Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 4-dimensional modulation direct detection system based on Stokes vector receiver and a novel reduced-complexity SSBI cancellation algorithm for signal linearization. A 480 Gb/s data rate over 80 km SSMF is achieved.

articleTitle: 83.33 Tb/s Coherent PDM-8PSK SDM-TDM Spatial Super-channel and High-speed Core-joint Switching System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a record 83.33 Tb/s switching capacity on a time-division spatial super-channel 2×2 switching node making use of core-joint, ns switching-speed and transparent electro-absorption optical switches.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of mid-IR Octave Spanning Supercontinuum Generation in Low Loss Silicon-Germanium Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report supercontinuum extending from 3 to 6μm generated in Si0.6Ge0.4/Si waveguide pumping with ~200fs pulses at 4.15μm. Experimentally measured low propagation loss (0.4dB/cm in range 3.8-5.0μm) and dispersion engineering waveguide allowed us achieving ~5mW useful average power.

articleTitle: Few-mode and Multicore Fiber Amplifiers Technology for SDM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The optical performances of few-mode and multicore fiber amplifiers will strongly influence the future of SDM for long-haul transmission. We review this topic with a special focus on a new generation of few-mode erbium-doped fiber.

articleTitle: Revolver Hollow-Core Fibers and Raman Fiber Lasers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Hollow-core silica fiber with optical losses of ∼1 dB/m at the wavelength of 4.4 μm is demonstrated. Based on this revolver fiber 4.4-μm fiber Raman laser is realized with output average power of 250 mW and quantum conversion efficiency as high as 36 %.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Absorption in Single-photon Detector and Ultrafast Mode-locked Laser Pulse Characterization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We observe novel nonlinear absorption in a bialkali-cathode single-photon detector, and propose mutual-correlation scheme to characterize precisely the time-jitter of ultrafast pulses, while demonstrate it with error less than 0.828 fs.

articleTitle: Realistic Model for Frequency-Dependent Crosstalk in Weakly-Coupled Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We established a realistic channel model that describes frequency-dependent crosstalk precisely for weakly-coupled multicore fibers. The crosstalk variations induced by relative time delay, polarization mode dispersion and calculation step size have been discussed.

articleTitle: InP Photonic Integrated Comb Generator made by a cascade of Optical Modulators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first InP photonic integrated comb generator made by cascading a DBR laser, one Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator and two phase modulators. The photonic circuit also includes a booster SOA at the output.

articleTitle: Silica Capillary based Whispering Gallery Mode Resonators and Functional Fiber Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel and compact silica capillary based Whispering Gallery Mode resonators and functional fiber devices are demonstrated with Fano resonances observed, while the temperature, refractive index and strain sensing are also investigated.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Lightpath Validation for SDN Controllers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a method to quickly and accurately evaluate the feasibility of an optical path in online routing scenarios. The method is based on performance metrics that compress the set of all feasible paths.

articleTitle: A Statistical Assessment of Networking Merit of 2MxN WSS
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We assess the networking impact in terms of blocking probability and device counts of a novel low-contention probability network node. We show no significant penalties with respect to full-CDC solutions in a metro network scenario.

articleTitle: Proactive Detection of Optical Cable Failure Caused by Water Freezing Using 1-μm-band Mode-Detection OTDR
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An experiment shows that information allowing the prediction of optical loss increases due to icing in cable conduits can be extracted by using OTDR measurements in the 2-LP mode region of the fibers under test.

articleTitle: Optical Phase Conjugation in Installed Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a record throughput of 5.7 Tbit/s employing an optical phase conjugator to jointly compensate chromatic dispersion and increase the nonlinear threshold in an installed optical network using commercially available lumped amplifiers.

articleTitle: Multipath Interference Free Multi-LED Visible Light Communications with Gold Sequence Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a multi-LED VLC system with low complexity Gold sequence multiplexed OFDM signals. Without time synchronization or uplink feedback mechanism, the received signal qualities are uniform and ubiquitously isolated from wireless multipath interferences.

articleTitle: High-Performance InP PIC Technology Development based on a Generic Photonic Integration Foundry
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We have achieved monolithic integration of photodetectors, DFB- and DBR lasers, SOAs, spot-size converters, polarization-rotators and splitters, EAMs, and passive-waveguide devices on InP technology. This generic foundry process provides endless possibilities for PIC designers.

articleTitle: Real-Time Traffic Management in AT&T's SDN-Enabled Core IP/Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: In late 2017, AT&T deployed an SDN controller that manages real-time traffic routing using a highly efficient optimization engine for its core IP network. The controller is being expanded to include optical transport layer, allowing network capacity to be dynamically adjusted in an integrated multi-layer manner. This results in a highly efficient network that dynamically adjusts to meet traffic growth, traffic shifts and network failures. This paper highlights some key learnings from the implementation and potential future work.

articleTitle: Solid Type Low-Latency Single-Mode Fiber with Large Effective Area and Low Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel solid type low-latency single-mode fiber (SMF) is proposed. Proposed small core dual-cladding structure successfully achieves a 0.3% latency reduction from a silica-core fiber while maintaining a 121.4 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective-area and 0.194 dB/km loss.

articleTitle: A 34Gbaud Linear Transimpedance Amplifier with Automatic Gain Control for 200Gb/s DP-16QAM Optical Coherent Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 34Gbaud TIA achieves 1.5% THD at 1mAppd input, 20pA/sqrt(Hz) input referred noise density, output amplitude of up to 1Vppd and maintains 27GHz bandwidth over 43dB of transimpedance gain dynamic range, enabling a 200Gb/s dual-polarization 16QAM coherent receiver operation.

articleTitle: The Software-Defined Flexible Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: ≫ Flexibility finally becoming a real driver in optical transport ≫ Software-level flexibility for automation, interoperability, driving down costs ≫ Hardware-level flexibility to allow actual service reconfiguration in a data-center centric world ≫ Applicable everywhere ≫ Transport line-side (rate/symbol-flexible interfaces) ≫ Transport client-side (backplane fabrics, modular clients) ≫ Router-Transport connection (FlexE enabled deployments) ≫ Unique design challenges ≫ Smart modelling help techno-economic evaluations ≫ Flexible hardware removes (some) uncertainty over design policies ≫ Open Transport ≫ At the optical level, disaggregation is more than integration and functional abstraction ≫ Steps to be taken in bridging open networks with performance-critical applications.

articleTitle: Cross-layer Aware Packet-Optical Link Management in Software-Defined Network Operating System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Software-defined network management systems presently lack joint link-status awareness on both packet and optical layers. Using a NOS with cross-layer link awareness, we demonstrate faster service restoration of packet links over failed optical links.

articleTitle: Physical Layer 1 Gb/s Secret Wireless Data Transmission at W-Band using a Photonic Duffing System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: First demonstration of photonically-enabled 1 Gb/s secret wireless data transmission at W-band based on Duffing chaotic systems. The presented results validate a new methodology to increase security by exploiting chaos for gigabit data transmissions.

articleTitle: Observing the Interaction of PMD with Generation of NLI in Uncompensated Amplified Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present simulative analyses displaying how PMD has negligible interaction with the generation of nonlinear interference, and show that the GN-model is accurate yet conservative in estimating the generalized SNR also in wide-bandwidth transmission.

articleTitle: 11.5 bits/s/Hz PM-256QAM Comb-Based Superchannel Transmission by Combining Optical and Digital Pilots
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 44 Tb/s transmission using three 50×24 Gbaud PM-256QAM comb-based superchannels. Each superchannel combines a single optical pilot tone with individual digital pilot symbols to minimize the total overhead, enabling record spectral-efficiency over the full C-band.

articleTitle: Fully Reconfigurable Silicon-Based Waveguide Bragg Grating for Integrated Microwave Photonic Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A fully reconfigurable silicon-based waveguide grating that is electrically reconfigurable for integrated microwave photonic applications is designed, fabricated and experimentally demonstrated. The employment of the grating to perform temporal differentiation and microwave frequency discrimination is reported.

articleTitle: Radio-over-Fiber-based Seamless Fiber-Wireless Convergence for Small Cell and Linear Cell Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present radio-over-fiber technologies for fiber and wireless convergence for small cell and linear cell networks, including a flexible and low-latency mobile fronthaul for ultra-dense small cells, and high-speed wireless backhaul system for high-speed trains.

articleTitle: 264 Gb/s Twin-SSB-KK Direct Detection Transmission Enabled by MIMO Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the transmission of 264 Gb/s twin-SSB-KK single carrier signals over 80 km SSMF, enabled by a novel MIMO processing scheme to remove the crosstalk between sideband signals caused by non-ideal optical filters.

articleTitle: Efficient Mobile Fronthaul Using Windowed OFDM Exhibiting High CFO Tolerance and Strong OOB-leakage Suppression with Low DSP Complexity
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel windowed-OFDM transmission scheme is demonstrated to achieve 2.2-dB improvement of carrier-frequency-offset tolerance and 20-dB out-of-band-leakage suppression for MMW-RoF mobile fronthaul, with low computational complexity and no additional overhead owing to effective time-domain windowing.

articleTitle: T/O-band Wavelength Routing System Using Quantum Dot Semiconductor Devices and 1081-Channel AWG Router
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelength routing system that covers a broad wavelength range of 1000–1360 nm, i.e., T/O-band. The system includes our developed T/O-band-specific quantum dot semiconductor devices and 1081-channel arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) router.

articleTitle: Exploring the Stokes Space by Non-Orthogonal Polarization Modulation for a Smooth Upgrade of Optical Link Capacity
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate transmission at 4 bits/symbol through 2-dimensional Stokes vector modulation while retaining a direct detection receiver. Robustness against channel-induced state transform is confirmed through measurements over 40 km of field-deployed fiber.

articleTitle: Tunable Multi-Wavelength EDF Laser Based on Sagnac Interferometer with Weakly-Coupled FMF Delay Line
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an EDF laser based on Sagnac interferometer with weakly-coupled FMF delay line. We experimentally demonstrate that it has high stability, an OSNR higher than 30-dB and a tuning range over 30-nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-large Mode Area Fibers for High Power Lasers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The most recent advances on ultra-large mode area fibers for high-power operation will be presented. Moreover, an approach to synthetize ultra-large mode area fibers that circumvents technical limitations by using multi-core fibers will be discussed.

articleTitle: The First Testbed Demonstration of Cognitive End-to-End Optical Service Provisioning with Hierarchical Learning across Multiple Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first experimental testbed with a hierarchical machine-learning network management framework for impairment-aware end-to-end elastic optical RMSA service provisioning across multi autonomous domains with QoT estimation deviations below 10%.

articleTitle: Record 560 Gb/s Single-Carrier and 850 Gb/s Dual-Carrier Transmission over Transoceanic Distances
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate record single-carrier 560-Gb/s over 6,600 km and 430-Gb/s transmission over 13,200 km, as well as dual-carrier 850-Gb/s over 6,600km, and 1-Tb/s over 3,960km, leveraging advanced DACs, wideband receiver, probabilistic shaping and nonlinear mitigation.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Power Coupling in Few-Mode Step Index Fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Power coupling in few-mode step index fibers is studied for different kinds of perturbation. The analysis shows that coupling may change depending on perturbation even in the asymptotic regime.

articleTitle: CMOS-Compatible Silicon Photonic IQ Modulator for 84 Gbaud 16QAM and 70 Gbaud 32QAM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Using an all-silicon modulator, we demonstrate single-polarization 336 Gb/s (84 Gbaud) 16QAM and 350 Gb/s (70 Gbaud) 32QAM at BER well below 20% FEC-threshold. We achieved a net rate of 291 Gb/s on a single polarization.

articleTitle: Transmitter-Embedded AMCC, LTE-A and OTDR signal for Direct Modulation Analog Radio over Fiber Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: AMCC, LTE-A and OTDR signals are embedded in a single transmitter. Experiments show little impact on data transmission under in-service monitoring. Fault localization capability is verified with 10 dB dynamic range and 10 m resolution.

articleTitle: Transmission of 80-GBd 16-QAM over 300 km and Kramers-Kronig Reception Using a Low-Complexity FIR Hilbert Filter Approximation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate Kramers-Kronig reception at a net rate of 267 Gb/s using a single high-bandwidth photodiode. We propose a low complexity DSP implementation, analyze back-to-back performance, and show transmission over up to 300 km.

articleTitle: Integrated Wavelength Selective Switch Array for Space Division Multiplexed Network with Ultra-Low Inter-Spatial Channel Crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel optics for integrated wavelength selective switch (WSS) array that suppresses inter-sub WSS crosstalk for space-division multiplexed network. A crosstalk level of as low as -50 dB has been achieved.

articleTitle: Achievable Information Rate Enhancement of Visible Light Communication Using Probabilistically Shaped OFDM Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a visible light communication (VLC) system based on the probabilistically shaped (PS) OFDM modulation. The overall achievable information rate (AIR) can be improved by 13.6% in comparison with conventional bit-loading scheme.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of FPGA-based Hitless Flexible Receiver with Blind Modulation Format Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a FPGA-based flexible receiver with real-time DSP that adapts to the modulation format of the incoming signal automatically. Hitless switching between 1.024-μs long QPSK and 16-QAM frames has been experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherent Analog Low Power, Small Size 400/200/100Gb/s Receiver Based on Bipolar SiGe Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate first to our knowledge analog coherent engine (ACE). Simulations show power consumption under 2W for 400Gb/s ACE. Combination of ACE with CMOS direct detection unit is good candidate for short reach communications.

articleTitle: Agile Optical Networking: Beyond Filtered Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Filterless optical networks based on broadcast-and-select nodes and coherent transceivers are attractive cost-effective and flexible solutions in core networks. In this paper, we explore the suitability of filterless architectures in metropolitan core and aggregation networks.

articleTitle: White Gaussian Noise Based Capacity Estimate and Characterization of Fiber-Optic Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We use white Gaussian noise as a test signal for single-mode and multimode transmission links and estimate the link capacity based on a calculation of mutual information. We also extract the complex amplitude channel estimations and mode-dependent loss with high accuracy.

articleTitle: EDF Length Dependence of Amplification Characteristics of Cladding Pumped 19-Core EDFA
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a C-band cladding pumped 19-core EDFA. Optimum EDF length and output power of the EDFA agree with those of a cladding pumped 7-core EDFA. High output power is brought by sufficiently long EDF.

articleTitle: Modular SDN-enabled S-BVT Adopting Widely Tunable MEMS VCSEL for Flexible/Elastic Optical Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an SDN-enabled S-BVT adopting directly-modulated tunable VCSEL with direct-detection for optical metro networks and spectrum defragmentation. We experimentally assess it over different network paths up to 185km and in presence of adjacent slices.

articleTitle: Integrated Frequency-Tunable Microwave Photonic Bandpass Filter on a Silicon Photonic Chip
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A photonic integrated frequency-tunable microwave photonic bandpass filter consisting of a high-speed phase modulator, a thermally-tunable high-Q microdisk resonator, and a high-speed photodetector, fully integrated on a silicon platform, is designed, fabricated and characterized.

articleTitle: Ultra-High Bandwidth InP IQ Modulator co-assembled with Driver IC for Beyond 100-GBd CDM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricated a driver modulator sub-assembly for beyond 100-GBd CDM by employing an optimized electrode and a co-designed driver IC. The sub-assembly exhibits an ultra-high bandwidth exceeding 67 GHz, which is sufficient for practical implementation.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient High-Throughput Staircase Decoders
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce staircase decoder implementations achieving up to 1-Tb/s throughput with energy dissipation of 1.2 pJ/information bit. The implementations are estimated to achieve >10.5 dB of net coding gain depending on the configuration.

articleTitle: Poly-Crystalline Silicon Waveguide Devices on Hollow Deep Trench Isolation in Standard Foundry Bulk Silicon Process
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate poly-crystalline silicon waveguide devices on deep-trench isolation in a commercial bulk 180nm SiGe BiCMOS process without any process modifications or post-processing. At 1550 nm, the measured loss for the poly-crystalline silicon waveguide and an MMI compatible with the waveguide are around 3.0 dB/mm and 0.38 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Sea-trial of an Ethernet-based Underwater VLC Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate at NATO site in Spezia a bi-directional underwater optical wireless transmission compliant with 10Base-T Ethernet. Zero packet-loss-was achieved up to 10 m distance in a real harbor, with shallow murky waters and daylight.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 30Gbit/s QPSK-to-PAM4 Data-Format and Wavelength Conversion to Enable All-Optical Gateway from Long-haul to Datacenter
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A tunable optical QPSK to PAM4 converter is experimentally demonstrated. The proposed method maps four symbols of QPSK signal to four different amplitude levels which can be directly detected in photo-diode. Open eyes are obtained for the detected PAM4 signal.

articleTitle: DSP-Enabled Frequency Locking for Near-Nyquist Spectral Efficiency Superchannels utilizing Integrated Photonics
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Digitally synthesized near-Nyquist subcarriers and photonic integration are shown to improve spectral efficiency. Spectral utilization 3.3% over baud rate is enabled by 1% Root-Raised-Cosine shaping and precision adjacent-channel wavelocking σ <;100 MHz.

articleTitle: Efficient Offline Evaluation of FEC Codes Based on Captured Data with Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a tool for reusing experimental or simulation data of probabilistically shaped signals with different FEC codes. A single recorded histogram of log-likelihood ratios is sufficient to examine arbitrary coding at low BERs.

articleTitle: Digitally Enhanced DAC: Low-Resolution Digital Pre-Compensation for High Speed Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel algorithm is proposed to overcome bandwidth limitation using low-resolution DACs. We demonstrate electrical back-to-back 32Gbaud QAM-64 over 11GHz and optical 32Gbaud QAM-4 over 5GHz using 4 bits and 2.6 bits DACs respectively.

articleTitle: Transmission of 4×50-Gb/s PAM-4 Signal over 80-km Single Mode Fiber using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We apply neural network algorithms with two kinds of input features as the nonlinear DSP method, and realize 4×50-Gb/s PAM-4 IM/DD transmission for 80-km fiber with ~2 dB power sensitivity improvement over conventional nonlinear algorithms.

articleTitle: An Accurate and Robust PDL Monitor by Digital Signal Processing in Coherent Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An accurate and robust PDL monitor based on receiver side DSP is proposed and experimentally verified. The standard deviation of monitor error is 0.1 dB and the method tolerates various imperfections, such as unsynchronized clock.

articleTitle: 112 Gb/s/λ CAP Signals Transmission over 480 km in IM-DD System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 112 Gbit/s/λ CAP over 480 km of SSMF with low-cost direct detection. A joint processing algorithm is employed to improve system performance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that single-wavelength 100G signal transmission is experimentally achieved over 480 km of SSMF with CAP-16 and direct detection.

articleTitle: Broadband SOI Mode Order Converter Based on Topology Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Topology optimized SOI mode order converters are proposed to allow mutual conversion between TE0, TE1 and TE2. Broadband conversion efficiency around 85% can be realized on an ultra-compact (~ 4 μm length) footprint.

articleTitle: Extended Reach 40km Transmission of C-Band Real-Time 53.125 Gbps PAM-4 Enabled with a Photonic Integrated Tunable Lattice Filter Dispersion Compensator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Reach-extended C-band transmission of real-time 53.125Gbps PAM-4 data over 40km SSMF is enabled using a dispersion compensating photonic-integrated programmable lattice filter. Transmission of 100GHz spaced channels error-free below the FEC threshold is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Stable Measurement of Effective Area in Coupled Multi-core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We achieved stable near-field and far-field patterns measurements and effective area evaluation of randomly coupled multi-core fibers by using a wide-bandwidth light source to average intensity over wavelength and eliminate time-varying intensity fluctuations.

articleTitle: A 50Gb/s-PAM4 CDR with On-Chip Eye Opening Monitor for Reference-Level and Clock-Sampling Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 50Gb/s-PAM4 Clock/Data Recovery (CDR) transceiver is designed in a 40nm-CMOS process. An on-chip Eye Opening Monitor (EOM) is introduced that enables adaptive reference level and timing sampling placement for non-uniform and distorted PAM4-inputs.

articleTitle: 180-GBaud All-ETDM Single-Carrier Polarization Multiplexed QPSK Transmission over 4480 km
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate PDM-QPSK transmission over 4480 km at a record all-electronically multiplexed symbol rate of 180 GBaud, providing a line rate of 720 Gb/s on a single optical carrier enabled by high-speed InP-DHBT selectors.

articleTitle: 93.34 Tbit/s/mode (280 Tbit/s) Transmission in a 3-Mode Graded-Index Few-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit 381×24.5 Gbaud PDM-64-QAM modulated channels per mode of a 30 km graded-index three-mode fiber, resulting in a record per-mode data-rate of 93.34 TBit/s and an aggregated net-data-rate of 280 Tbit/s.

articleTitle: 106-Gbit/s PAM4 40-km Transmission Using an Avalanche Photodiode With 42-GHz Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 106-Gbit/s PAM4 transmission over 40-km single-mode fiber is demonstrated using an avalanche photodiode (APD) with a gap-grading layer for high-speed operation. The APD shows maximum bandwidth of 42GHz with 0.5-A/W responsivity at unity gain.

articleTitle: Mobile Xhaul Evolution: Enabling Tools for a Flexible 5G Xhaul Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This work is partially supported by the R&D contract “Wiredand-Wireless Converged Radio Access Network for Massive IoT Traffic (FY2017-2020)” with the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Japan, for radio resource enhancement.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of DDoS Mitigation over a Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Network Using Software Defined Networking (SDN)
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, DDoS mitigation of QKD-based networks utilizing a software defined network application. Successful quantum-secured link allocation is achieved after a DDoS attack based on real-time monitoring of quantum parameters.

articleTitle: A Compact Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Platform with Arrayed Waveguide Gratings and MMIs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We design and demonstrate a thin-film z-cut Lithium Niobate photonic platform. We report experimental transmission measurement of different passive photonic building blocks at 1.55 μm central wavelength including AWG and MMI splitter.

articleTitle: Distributed Aggregation and Reception of a 400-Gb/s Net Rate Superchannel in a Single-Photodiode 110-GHz Kramers-Kronig Receiver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We use a distributed superchannel aggregation scheme to demonstrate ultra-wideband single-photodiode reception based on inherently polarization-aligned Kramers-Kronig carrier generation at the receiver. The impact of polarization rotations is discussed. 400-Gb/s capacity is demonstrated for optimized conditions.

articleTitle: A 520-nm Green GaN LED with High Bandwidth and Low Current Density for Gigabits OFDM Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We develop 520-nm green GaN LEDs with a 340-MHz E-O bandwidth. For the first time, an OFDM signal modulates the green LED, which data rate achieves 2.16 Gb/s at a low current density 679 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Simultaneous Multiple ONUs Activation in WDM-PON System for 5G Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrate simultaneous activation of multiple ONUs by the random waiting time function in upstream transmission of registration request and random function of sweep start wavelength of tunable filter at ONU in WDM-PON system.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Multi-Rate DCO-CFP2 Interface for DCI, Metro, and Long-Haul Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, a 100/200-Gbps DP-QPSK/8QAM/16QAM silicon photonic DCO-CFP2 interface using various FECs and consuming less than 19 Watts is presented and evaluated. Performances make the transceiver compliant with DCI, metro/regional, LH, and ULH applications.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Silicon Multi-mode Waveguide Bend Based on Subwavelength Asymmetric Y-junction
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact multi-mode bend composed of a pair of asymmetric Y junction based on inverse-designed subwavelength structures is proposed and experimentally demonstrated with inter-mode crosstalk <; -24 dB, a footprint of 3.6 × 3.6 μm2.

articleTitle: High-Speed and Handover-Free Communications for High-Speed Trains Using Switched WDM Fiber-Wireless System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A high-speed, handover-free communication for high-speed trains by a switched WDM fiber-wireless system in the W-band is presented. More than 20 Gb/s signal transmission with a cell switching time of less than 4 μs is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Gray-Encoded Set-Partition 8QAM for Per-wavelength 200-Gb/s Application
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A simple Gray-encoding scheme, using a pair of small-sized tables, to reduce the non-Gray penalty for set-partition 8QAM is demonstrated. The experimental results show that a 42.3-GBd PDM-SP-8QAM signal, for 200-Gb/s per channel use, can exhibit ~0.5-dB OSNR benefit with this encoding method.

articleTitle: Silicon Chip-to-Chip Mode-Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A chip-to-chip mode-division multiplexing connection is demonstrated using a pair of multiplexers/demultiplexers fabricated on the silicon-on-insulator platform. Successful mode multiplexing and demultiplexing is experimentally demonstrated, using the LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11a</inf> and LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11b</inf> modes.

articleTitle: Recent Progress and Outlook on Multicore Fiber for Practical Use
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent achievement on uncoupled MCF for practical use. We introduce 4-core MCF with 125μm cladding which has upgradability from standard SMF system to MCF system, connecting technology and ultra-high density MCF-cable.

articleTitle: Multimode EDFA Designs with Reduced MDG by Considering Spatially Dependent Saturation Effects
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a spatial gain equalization strategy for multimode EDFAs which considers transversally non-uniform saturation. Characteristic minima of the MDG are observed along the fiber. The fiber length is adjusted to achieve low MDG.

articleTitle: C + L Band Distributed Few-mode Raman Amplification with Flattened Gain for Mode-division-multiplexed Optical Transmission over 75-km Few-mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We first experimentally demonstrate a C + L band few-mode Raman amplifier with 4-dB flat on-off gain. In the 1530-1605 nm range, the wavelength dependent gain for both LP01 and LP11 modes is less than 0.6-dB. The amplifier was successfully employed in MDM transmission.

articleTitle: Probabilistically Shaped 1024-QAM OFDM Transmission in an IM-DD System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 28.95 Gbit/s/λ PS-1024-QAM DFT-S OFDM over 40 km of SSMF in a low-cost IM-DD system. A 1.85 Gbit/s capacity increment is achieved using PS-1024-QAM format. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time to employ high order PS-QAM format in OFDM modulation.

articleTitle: W-band Radio-over-fiber Link Based on Self-oscillating Optical Frequency Comb Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 94.8 GHz radio-over-fiber link was implemented with a self-oscillating frequency comb. An LTE Advanced OFDM FDD 64-QAM signal of 20 MHz bandwidth was transmitted over 1.3 m wireless distance with an EVM of 2.23%.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-tolerant 8D Modulation Formats by Set-partitioning PDM-QPSK
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present two new nonlinearity tolerant modulation formats at spectral efficiencies lower than 4bits/4D-symbol, obtained using a simplified bit-to-symbol mapping approach to set-partition PDM-QPSK in 8 dimensions.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Loss Silica Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent advances in optical fiber technologies that realize ultra-low losses as low as 0.142 dB/km including pure-silica core and reduction of microscopic density fluctuation.
