articleTitle: Flex-Rate Transmission using Hybrid Probabilistic and Geometric Shaped 32QAM
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A novel algorithm to design geometric shaped 32QAM to work with probabilistic shaping is proposed to approach the Shannon limit within ~0.2 dB in SNR. The experimental results show ~0.2 dB SNR advantage over 64Gbaud PAS-64QAM, and flex-rate transmission demonstrates > 500 km reach improvement over 32QAM.

articleTitle: Optical Beamformer for K-band Smart Antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Beam forming using a 4×1 phased array with an optical feed network for K-band smart antenna systems is presented. Up to 45 degree steering angles are achieved. Wireless transmission throughputs of up to 3 Gbit/s using 32-OFDM subcarriers are achieved for the attained steering angles.

articleTitle: 4 OAM × 4 WDM Optical Switching Based on an Innovative Integrated Tunable OAM Multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A 4OAMx4WDM switching experiment has been carried out combining an innovative integrated tunable OAM multiplexer based on 4-concentric omega-shaped silicon waveguides and a refractive element-based OAM demultiplexer; operation is demonstrated up to 120Gb/s.

articleTitle: All-Optical Signal Processing Techniques for Flexible Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 1. Optical signal processing could add tunable and reconfigurable functions in physical layer that can enhance network flexibility 2. Flexible conversion between different levels of modulations formats without O/E/O conversions enable transparent gateways between optical networks and efficient use of fiber spectral resources 3. Reconfigurable bandwidth allocation in flex-grid optical network can improve spectral efficiency by fragmentation and overlapping optical channels. 4. Phase sensitive amplification could be beneficial for in-line optical signal regeneration. Raman assistant further enhances the parametric amplification in a phase-sensitive amplifier.

articleTitle: VCSEL-Based Optical Transceivers for Future Data Center Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Single transceiver data rates are now pushing past 100Gbps using line rates of 25Gbps by means of both spatial and wavelength division multiplexing. The next step is to push line rates in excess of 50Gbps, achieving transceiver data rates of more than 400Gbps. Progress on VCSELs and Photodiodes for 50Gbps/channel data links is reported for both PAM4 and NRZ modulation formats.

articleTitle: Blind Compensation of Nonlinear Waveform Distortions in Radio-over-Fiber System
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a DSP-based nonlinearity compensation technique for RoF links which does not require any prior knowledge about the links. By using this technique, we successfully transport twelve 198-MHz-bandwidth 64-QAM f-OFDM signals over 20 km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Progress toward an Open, SDN-controlled Photonic Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: AT&T is moving to a photonic layer that is fully software-controlled and open. This allows us to deliver bandwidth when and where it is needed, and to optimize the network as it grows and changes.

articleTitle: Contentionless Twin 8×24 WSS with Low Insertion Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A contentionless Twin 8×24 WSS has been designed and manufactured in prototype quantities. Measured insertion loss was between 3.3 dB and 6.8 dB for all port combinations, the lowest loss ever reported for a contentionless MxN WSS.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhancement for an Optical Access Link by using a Frequency Interleaved DAC
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present the experimental realization of the frequency interleaved DAC concept for an IM/DD based access link. The first open 80 GBd PAM-4 electrical eye diagram of the frequency-interleaved DAC without using post-equalization is presented.

articleTitle: Irregular Polar Turbo Product Coding for High-Throughput Optical Interface
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose polar turbo product code (TPC) to enable parallel/pipeline decoding, for high-throughput transmission. With irregular polar codes, the computational complexity and latency can be significantly reduced, yet outperforming BCH-constituent TPC by 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Real-time Downstream 25Gbit/s PAM4 for High Speed TDM-PONs with both 25 and 12.5Gbit/s ONUs
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally achieved 40km, real-time, N1 ODN class (29dB) compliant PAM4 transmission with PAM4/NRZ receptions on the same PON. The emitted PAM4 is interpreted either as PAM4 or NRZ to allow full or half line-rates.

articleTitle: Photonic Design Parameters for AWG-Based RF Channelized Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An 11-channel 1-GHz bandwidth silicon photonic AWG was fabricated and measured in the lab. Two photonic architectures are presented: (1) RF-envelope detector, and (2) RF down-convertor for digital systems. The RF-envelope detector architecture was modeled based on the demonstrated AWG characteristics to determine estimated system-level RF receiver performance.

articleTitle: Benefits of Performance Awareness in Coherent Dynamic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Awareness of optical network performance and its accurate prediction enables squeezing of margins allocated for stable operation. We discuss potential of online performance assessment by leveraging functionalities of bandwidth variable transponders in flexible optical networks.

articleTitle: Superior BER Transmission of 106-Gb/s/lane Skewless PAM4 over 10 km by Utilizing 1.3-μm Directly Modulated InGaAlAs-MQW BH Lasers and Incoherent Multiplexing of Two NRZ Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We firstly demonstrate incoherent multiplexing of two NRZ signals utilizing directly modulated lasers transmits 106-Gb/s/lane PAM-4 signals over 10 km without non-linear compensation. Skewless eye diagram of this method attained lower BERs than conventional method.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated III-V Lasers Fabricated Using Epitaxial Growth on an InP/SiO2/Si Substrate
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a III-V/Si integration technology that employs epitaxially-grown active layers on an InP/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si substrate for low-cost fabrication of PICs. Based on it, a directly-modulated membrane-laser array exhibiting a low, VCSEL-like operating energy is reported.

articleTitle: Analog Optical Signaling for Large Scale Radio Telescopes in Harsh Environments
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present optical analog signaling technologies, developed specifically for the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). SKA will be the world's largest radio telescope when finished, combining thousands of antennas installed in remote and harsh environments.

articleTitle: Demonstration of SDN Application for Multilayer Video Contribution Network Service
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This paper describes a demonstration of an end-to-end, SDN-controlled Video Contribution Network providing dynamic service set-up, using optical switching to enable flexible provisioning of resources. We show seamless operation of legacy and future technologies.

articleTitle: CAPEX Optimization with Joint Allocation of Hybrid RF/FSO and Optical Fibre Resources in 5G Backhaul
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We optimize CAPEX of a 5G backhaul with hybrid RF/FSO links and storage by exploiting matching between source nodes and destination nodes for allocation of links to minimize total required resources.

articleTitle: Joint Jobs Scheduling and Routing for Metro-Scaled Micro Datacenters over Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A joint jobs scheduling and routing algorithm is proposed for geographically-distributed micro datacenters over EON. Simulation results show that the algorithm can reduce the jobs' average completion time and bandwidth consumption.

articleTitle: Seawater Communication with Blue Laser Carried 16-QAM OFDM at 3.7 GBaud
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Point-to-point seawater communication based on directly 16-QAM OFDM encoded 450-nm blue laser is performed to carry the data with 2.7 GBaud (10.8 Gbps) and 3.7 GBaud (14.8-Gbps) for transmission over 10.2 m and 1.7 m.

articleTitle: Reliability Gains of Infrastructure Programmability in an Optical C-RAN
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We study the interplay of optical, wireless, and control domains in a software-defined C-RAN architecture in terms of survivability. Our analysis indicates the significant advantage of optical network programmability under a negligible fronthaul latency penalty.

articleTitle: Inter-channel Stimulated Raman Scattering and its Impact in Wideband Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of inter-channel stimulated Raman scattering (ISRS) in wideband optical transmission systems is studied. ISRS cross-talk due to channel modulation was found to be negligible and a good agreement was found with theoretical results.

articleTitle: Optimum VCSEL Apertures for High-Speed Multimode Fiber Links
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Cross-correlations of VCSEL transverse mode groups with different apertures are used to predict dispersion dependent RIN. Experiments with wideband multimode fiber confirm the noise enhancement dependence on aperture, which increases with fewer mode VCSELs.

articleTitle: A Compact 212.5-Gbit/s Transmitter Optical Sub-Assembly with DMLs and Quad Linear Driver
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present a compact 212.5-Gbit/s transmitter optical sub-assembly equipped with directly modulated lasers and quad 53.125-Gbit/s linear driver. We demonstrate high-quality and high-output-power operation with low-power consumption (1.01 W), which is desirable for 200GBASE-LR4 application.

articleTitle: Coupled-Core EDFA Compatible with FMF Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report a 6-core coupled-core fiber amplifier compatible with 6-mode FMF. The coupled-core amplifier not only reduces mode dependent gain but also introduces strong random mode mixing, thus easing mode dependent impairments in FMF transmission systems.

articleTitle: Low-loss Silicon Photonic Switch Module Technology and Its Use for to Transponder Aggregators in Optical Network Nodes
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonic switches are attractive for extensible optical switch systems required for optical networks in telecom areas and datacenters. We show our low-loss silicon photonic switch modules and their application to CDC-ROADMs using multiple modules.

articleTitle: 60-km Transmission of 28-Gb/s QPSK Upstream Signal in RSOA-based WDM PON Using SBS Suppression Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the 60-km transmission of 28-Gb/s QPSK signal in RSOA-based coherent WDM PON. The frequency dithering of seed laser and fast carrier phase estimator are employed to suppress the SBS and track the laser's phase, respectively.

articleTitle: A 128 Gb/s PAM4 Silicon Microring Modulator
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We report a silicon microring modulator with 128 Gb/s PAM4 data rate, 0.52 V·cm phase efficiency, 50 GHz electro-optic bandwidth, and a full-FSR tunability using an integrated heater with efficiency <;20mW/π-phase shift.

articleTitle: A PMD-adaptive DBP Receiver Based on SNR Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel adaptive digital backpropagation (DBP) scheme that tracks the fiber polarization-mode dispersion via the optimization of the signal-to-noise ratio. Gains of up to 1.4 dB over conventional DBP are achieved.

articleTitle: Numerical Estimation of Nonlinear Impairments in a 62.5 μm MMF for MDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: The nonlinear propagation in a multimode fiber using 78 spatial modes is investigated numerically. We show that nonlinear impairments are no obstacle for using fibers with such a high mode count for mode-division multiplexing.

articleTitle: Multichannel Analog and Digital Signal Transmission with Watt-Class Electrical Power Delivery by Means of Power-over-Fiber Using a Double-Clad Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully achieved high transmission performance of multichannel analog and digital signals with over 7-Watt electrical power delivery by means of power-over-fiber using a double-clad fiber, for the first time.

articleTitle: Integrated Optical-Wireless Resource Slicing Management for 5G Service-based Architecture and Multi-level RAN
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: This demo provides an integrated end-to-end optical-wireless slicing cross latest SBA based core network, backhaul network and two-level fronthaul networks, showing consistent heterogeneous coordination capabilities on different multi-vendor transport equipment and computing resources.

articleTitle: CASTOR: An Architecture to Bring Cognition to Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: CASTOR architecture to enable cognitive networking is demonstrated. Extended nodes make local decisions, whilst a centralized system beside the network controller makes network-wide decisions. Interaction with ONOS, Net2Plan, and passive monitoring devices is exhibited.

articleTitle: Non-circularly-symmetric Mode-group Demultiplexer Based on Fused-type FMF Coupler for MGM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A mode-group demultiplexer (MG-DEMUX) based on fused-type FMF coupler is proposed and fabricated for the LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode group, based on which 2×5-Gb/s weakly-coupled MGM transmission over 10-km TMF is experimentally demonstrated with simple direct detection.

articleTitle: Integrated InP Polarization Rotator Using the Plasmonic Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: An InP based polarization rotator is demonstrated using the plasmonic effect. It operates as a half-wave retarder. Simple device structure ensures large fabrication tolerance. The device exhibits polarization extinction ratio of 20 dB over C-band.

articleTitle: Comparison of WDM Bandwidth Loading Using Individual Transponders, Shaped, and Flat ASE Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Channel emulation is compared for 100-Gb/s PDM-QPSK from commercial transponders with channel-like spectrally carved noise and flat noise bands. The performance is evaluated in experiments and simulations on standard SMF and TW-RS DWDM transmission links.

articleTitle: Enabling Component Technologies for Space Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present an overview of recent progress on SDM components. In particular, we will discuss in detail various recently developed SDM fiber isolators, pump couplers and mode field diameter adaptors.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Variable-Length Output Distribution Matching with Periodical Distribution Uniformalization
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Run-length code based distribution matching (DM) for probabilistic shaping is combined with a uniformalizer to realize low-complexity fixed-length DM. The proposed method is 0.4 dB better than previous low-complexity DM methods.

articleTitle: A Fully-integrated Multi-λ Hybrid DML Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A multi-wavelength, hybrid directly-modulated laser (DML) transmitter with integrated thermal shunt, MOS capacitor and CMOS driver circuit is fabricated. 14 Gb/s operation from conventional direct current modulation and a novel MOS-type laser modulation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-Speed Heterogeneous InP-on-Si Capacitive Phase Modulators
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We present O-band InP-on-Si phase modulators with 0.5dB IL, 1V·cm V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L and >25GHz bandwidth for 250μm long sections. 25 Gbps operation without optical amplifiers or pre-emphasis is demonstrated with an MZM integrating such phase modulators.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Unicast, Anycast, Multicast and Manycast Traffics in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We estimate a hybrid communication scheme with unicast, anycast, multicast and manycast traffics in elastic optical networks. A request classification gene encoding based approach is proposed which optimizes hybrid traffics jointly to improve network efficiency.

articleTitle: Throughput Scaling for MMF-Enabled Optical Datacenter Networks by Time-Slicing-Based Crosstalk Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Modal crosstalk is the main bottleneck in MMF-enabled optical datacenter networks with direct detection. A novel time-slicing-based crosstalk-mitigated MDM scheme is first proposed, then theoretically analyzed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical-Based Underwater Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: A high-speed 24 Gb/s PAM4 optical-based underwater communication (OBUC) with afocal scheme for reducing/expanding collimated beam diameter is demonstrated. Such proposed OBUC link is better than existing OBUC given its practicability for high-speed underwater link.

articleTitle: Towards Secure Optical Networks: A Framework to Aid Localization of Harmful Connections
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We model the scope of optical signal insertion attacks by defining attack syndromes for each connection, and present a cost-efficient routing heuristic that aids localization of harmful connections by reducing syndrome ambiguity in the network.

articleTitle: Zn-Diffusion/Oxide-Relief 940 nm VCSELs with Excellent High-Temperature Performance for 50 Gbit/sec Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 940nm VCSELs with small resistances (35Ω) and ultra-wide E-O bandwidths from room-temperature (31GHz) to 85°C (29GHz) operations are demonstrated. It achieves 50Gbps error-free transmission over 50m OM5 fiber without using equalization and pre-emphasis techniques.

articleTitle: The Role of Open-source Network Optimization Software in the SDN/NFV World
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: 1. Introduction 2. Use cases 3. Optimization software: a review of the solvers 4. Network optimization software: Net2Plan 5. Wrap up.

articleTitle: Application of Tomlinson-Harashima Precoding (THP) for Short-Reach Band-Limited Nyquist PAM and Faster-Than-Nyquist PAM Signaling
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally prove the effectiveness of Tomlinson-Harashima Precoding for IM/DD Nyquist PAM signals with severe transmitter-side bandwidth limitation despite the increase of optical signal levels, and its application to 50-GBaud Faster-Than-Nyquist PAM4 is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Components for High Speed 5G Access
publicationTitle: 2018 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exposition (OFC)
abstract: Emerging access networks require specific components. We present a counter-heating method for wavelength stabilization in NG-PON2 TWDM-PON systems, and a +6dBm-high-power externally modulated laser at 10Gb/s and 28Gb/s for XGS-PON or 25G-EPON systems.
